title.zh: 卷一百二十九 列傳第十六: 來阿八赤 紐璘 阿剌罕 阿塔海 唆都 李恒
title.en: Volume 129 Biographies 16: Lai'abachi, Niulin, Alahan, Atahai, Suodou, Li Heng
title.raw: 卷一百二十九 列傳第十六: 來阿八赤 紐璘 阿剌罕 阿塔海 唆都 李恒 Volume 129 Biographies 16: Lai'abachi, Niulin, Alahan, Atahai, Suodou, Li Heng

sentences.zh: 来阿八赤

translations.literal: Lai'abachi
translations.idiomatic: Lai'abachi

sentences.zh: 来阿八赤，宁夏人。

translations.literal: Lai'abachi was a native of Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: Lai'abachi was from Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 父术速忽里，归太祖，选居宿卫，继命掌膳事。

translations.literal: His father Shusuhuli submitted to Taizu, was selected to serve in the imperial guard, and was subsequently appointed to manage the imperial kitchen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shusuhuli had submitted to Taizu, been chosen for the imperial guard, and later put in charge of the imperial kitchens.

sentences.zh: 宪宗即位，大举伐宋，攻钓鱼山，命诸将议进取之计，术速忽里言于帝曰：「川蜀之地，三分我有其二，所未附者巴江以下数十州而已，地削势弱，兵粮皆仰给东南，故死守以抗我师。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xianzong took the throne, he launched a major campaign against Song, attacking Diaoyu Mountain, and ordered the generals to discuss plans for advancing. Shusuhuli said to the Emperor: "Of the lands of Chuan-Shu, two-thirds are already ours; what remains un-submitted are only several dozen prefectures south of the Ba River. Their territory is diminished and their strength weakened; soldiers and grain all depend on supplies from the southeast, hence they hold out desperately to resist our army.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xianzong came to the throne he mounted a major campaign against Song and laid siege to Diaoyu Mountain. When he asked his generals how best to advance, Shusuhuli told him: "We already hold two-thirds of Sichuan. Only a few dozen prefectures south of the Ba River still hold out. Their territory is shrunken and their position weak; troops and grain all depend on the southeast, so they are fighting to the death to hold us off.

sentences.zh: 蜀地岩险，重庆、合州又其籓屏，皆新筑之城，依险为固，今顿兵坚城之下，未见其利。

translations.literal: The terrain of Shu is rugged and perilous; Chongqing and Hezhou are its bulwarks as well—these are all newly built cities, fortified by relying on the terrain. Now we have halted our army below these strong cities without yet seeing the benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan is rugged and hard to traverse. Chongqing and Hezhou are its outer defenses—newly built cities that lean on the terrain for strength. Keeping our army pinned beneath such strongholds brings no clear gain.

sentences.zh: 曷若城二城之间，选锐卒五万，命宿将守之，与成都旧兵相出入，不时扰之，以牵制其援师。

translations.literal: Why not encamp between the two cities, select fifty thousand crack troops, assign veteran commanders to hold them, and send them in and out together with the old troops at Chengdu, harassing the enemy from time to time to tie down their relief forces?
translations.idiomatic: Better to build camps between the two cities, pick fifty thousand elite troops, put veteran commanders in charge, and let them move in and out with the garrison at Chengdu, raiding whenever opportunity allows to pin down Song relief columns.

sentences.zh: 然后我师乘新集之锐，用降人为乡导，水陆东下，破忠、涪、万、夔诸小郡，平其城，俘其民，俟冬水涸，瞿唐三峡不日可下，出荆楚，与鄂州渡江诸军合势，如此则东南之事一举可定。

translations.literal: Then our army, riding the edge of newly assembled vigor, using surrendered men as guides, would descend eastward by land and water, break the smaller prefectures of Zhong, Fu, Wan, and Kui, level their cities and take their people captive; when winter comes and the waters recede, the Three Gorges of Qutang could be taken in no time. Emerging into Jing-Chu and joining forces with the armies crossing the Yangzi at Ezhou—in this way the affairs of the southeast could be settled in one stroke.
translations.idiomatic: Our forces could then strike while morale is fresh, use defectors as guides, and drive east by land and water through the smaller prefectures of Zhong, Fu, Wan, and Kui—taking their towns and people. When winter low water opens the Qutang Gorge, we can break into Jing-Chu, join the armies crossing the Yangzi from Ezhou, and settle the southeast in one campaign.

sentences.zh: 其上流重庆、合州，孤危无援，不降即走矣。」

translations.literal: Upstream, Chongqing and Hezhou, isolated and without support, would either surrender or flee."
translations.idiomatic: Chongqing and Hezhou upstream, cut off and unsupported, would surrender or flee."

sentences.zh: 诸将曰「攻城则功在顷刻」，反以其言为迂，卒不用。

translations.literal: The generals said, "Storming cities brings merit in an instant," and on the contrary regarded his words as impractical; in the end they were not adopted.
translations.idiomatic: The generals replied that storming cities would win glory in a moment, dismissed his plan as roundabout, and never adopted it.

sentences.zh: 于是博选宿卫中材力可任用者，以阿八赤奉命往监元帅纽邻军，遏宋人援兵，驻重庆下流之铜罗峡，夹江据崖为垒。

translations.literal: Thereupon [the emperor] widely selected from the imperial guard those of talent and strength fit for service, and ordered Abaqi to supervise the army of Marshal Niulin and block Song relief troops, stationing at Tongluo Gorge below Chongqing, building fortifications on both banks clinging to the cliffs.
translations.idiomatic: The court then picked the ablest men from the imperial guard and sent Abaqi to oversee Marshal Niulin's army, block Song reinforcements, and camp at Tongluo Gorge downstream from Chongqing, building cliff-side forts on both banks of the river.

sentences.zh: 宋都统甘顺自夔州溯流西上，乘舟来攻。

translations.literal: Song Commander-in-Chief Gan Shun came upriver from Kuizhou by boat to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Song commander Gan Shun sailed up from Kuizhou to attack.

sentences.zh: 阿八赤预积薪于二垒，明火鼓噪，矢石如雨，顺流而进。

translations.literal: Abaqi had firewood piled beforehand at the two forts; with bright fires and clamorous drums, arrows and stones fell like rain as [the Song fleet] advanced downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Abaqi had stacked fuel at both forts. When the Song fleet came downstream he lit fires, beat drums, and rained arrows and stones upon them.

sentences.zh: 宋人力战不能支，退保西岸，敛兵自固。

translations.literal: The Song forces fought hard but could not hold; they withdrew to guard the west bank and drew in their troops to consolidate.
translations.idiomatic: The Song troops fought hard but gave way, pulled back to the west bank, and regrouped.

sentences.zh: 黎明复至，阿八赤身率精兵，缘崖而下，战舰复进，宋人败走，杀伤数千人。

translations.literal: At dawn they came again; Abaqi personally led elite troops down along the cliffs, and the warships advanced once more. The Song forces were defeated and fled; several thousand were killed or wounded.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn they returned. Abaqi led elite troops down the cliffs while his ships pressed forward again. The Song army broke and fled; thousands were killed or wounded.

sentences.zh: 帝闻而壮之，赐银二铤。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard and admired this; he bestowed two ingots of silver.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was impressed and rewarded him with two silver ingots.

sentences.zh: 宪宗崩，阿八赤从父倍道归燕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xianzong died, Abaqi followed his father home to Yan by forced marches.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xianzong died, Abaqi hurried north with his father to Yan.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，问以川蜀之事，阿八赤历陈始末，诵其父前所言以对，世祖抚掌曰：「当时若从此策，东南其足平乎！

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, he asked about affairs in Chuan-Shu. Abaqi recounted the whole course of events and repeated what his father had said before in reply. The Emperor clapped his hands and said: "Had we followed that plan then, could the southeast not have been pacified?
translations.idiomatic: After Kublai took the throne he asked about the Sichuan campaign. Abaqi laid out what had happened and quoted his father's earlier advice. The emperor clapped his hands and said, "If we had followed that plan, would the southeast still be unconquered?

sentences.zh: 朕在鄂渚，日望上流之声势耳。」

translations.literal: When I was at Ezhou, I looked daily for news of action from upstream."
translations.idiomatic: When I was at Ezhou I waited every day for word from up the river."

sentences.zh: 至元七年，南征襄樊，发河南、北器械粮储悉聚于淮西之义阳。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan, on the southern campaign against Xiang and Fan, weapons and grain stores from Henan and the north were all gathered at Yiyang in western Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7, during the campaign against Xiangyang and Fancheng, arms and grain from Henan and the north were concentrated at Yiyang on the western Huai.

sentences.zh: 虑宋人剽掠，命阿八赤督运，二日而毕。

translations.literal: Fearing Song raiders, [the court] ordered Abaqi to supervise transport; it was completed in two days.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing Song raids, the court put Abaqi in charge of transport; he finished in two days.

sentences.zh: 既还，世祖大悦，以银一铤赐之。

translations.literal: When he returned, Emperor Shizu was greatly pleased and bestowed one ingot of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On his return the emperor was delighted and gave him a silver ingot.

sentences.zh: 十四年，立尚膳院，授中顺大夫、同知尚膳院事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Imperial Kitchen Directorate was established; he was appointed Grand Master of Palace Attendance and Associate Director of the Imperial Kitchen Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 the Imperial Kitchen Directorate was founded and he was made associate director with the rank of Grand Master of Palace Attendance.

sentences.zh: 十八年，佩三珠虎符，授通奉大夫、益都等路宣慰使、都元帅。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he wore the three-pearl tiger tally and was appointed Grand Master for Court Audience, Pacification Commissioner of Yidu and other circuits, and Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he received the three-pearl tiger tally and was appointed pacification commissioner of Yidu and other circuits and grand marshal, with the rank of Grand Master for Court Audience.

sentences.zh: 发兵万人开运河，阿八赤往来督视，寒暑不辍。

translations.literal: Ten thousand troops were mobilized to open the canal; Abaqi went back and forth supervising, never ceasing through heat or cold.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand men were sent to dig the canal. Abaqi oversaw the work in person through summer and winter without pause.

sentences.zh: 有两卒自伤其手，以示不可用，阿八赤檄枢密并行省奏闻，斩之以惩不律。

translations.literal: Two soldiers wounded their own hands to show they were unfit for duty; Abaqi memorialized through the Bureau of Military Affairs and the Branch Secretariat, and they were beheaded to punish indiscipline.
translations.idiomatic: Two soldiers maimed their hands to avoid service. Abaqi reported them through the military bureau and branch secretariat and had them executed as a warning.

sentences.zh: 运河既开，迁胶莱海道漕运使。

translations.literal: Once the canal was opened, he was transferred to be Transport Commissioner of the Jiao-Lai sea route.
translations.idiomatic: When the canal was finished he was made transport commissioner for the Jiao-Lai sea route.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，调同佥宣徽院事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to be Associate Controller of the Imperial Entertainments Office.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 he was transferred to the Imperial Entertainments Office as associate controller.

sentences.zh: 辽左不宁，复降虎符，授征东招讨使。

translations.literal: When eastern Liaodong was unsettled, a tiger tally was again bestowed and he was appointed Pacification Commissioner for the Eastern Campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When eastern Liaodong grew restless he received a new tiger tally and was made pacification commissioner for the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 阿八赤招徠降附，期以自新，远近帖然。

translations.literal: Abaqi summoned and received those who surrendered, giving them a chance to reform; near and far became settled.
translations.idiomatic: Abaqi brought in those who submitted, offered them a fresh start, and soon the region was quiet from end to end.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，授征东宣慰使、都元帅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was appointed Pacification Commissioner for the Eastern Campaign and Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he was made eastern pacification commissioner and grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 皇子镇南王征交趾，授湖广等处行中书省右丞，召见，世祖亲解衣衣之，并金玉束带及弓矢甲胄赐焉。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Zhennan campaigned against Jiaozhi, [Abaqi] was appointed Right Chancellor of the Branch Secretariat of Huguang and elsewhere. Summoned to audience, Emperor Shizu personally removed his own garment to clothe him, and also bestowed a jade-and-gold girdle as well as bow, arrows, and armor.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Zhennan marched on Annam, Abaqi was made right chancellor of the Huguang branch secretariat. At court Kublai took off his own robe and put it on him, and gave him a jade-and-gold belt, bow and arrows, and armor.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，改湖广等处行尚书省右丞，诏四省所发士马，俾阿八赤阅视。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was changed to Right Chancellor of the Branch Department of State Affairs of Huguang and elsewhere; an edict ordered that troops and horses sent out from the four provinces be inspected by Abaqi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 he became right chancellor of the Huguang branch department of state affairs, and was ordered to inspect troops and horses raised by the four provinces.

sentences.zh: 九月，领中卫亲军千人，翊导皇子至思明州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he led a thousand personal troops of the Central Guard to escort the prince to Siming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he led a thousand Central Guard troops escorting the prince to Siming.

sentences.zh: 贼阻险拒守，于是选精锐与贼战于女兒关，斩馘万计，余兵弃关走。

translations.literal: The rebels held the defiles and resisted; thereupon he selected crack troops to fight the rebels at Nü'er Pass, beheading tens of thousands; the remaining enemy abandoned the pass and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy held the passes. Abaqi picked elite troops, fought them at Nü'er Pass, and killed tens of thousands; the rest abandoned the pass and ran.

sentences.zh: 于是大军深入，进至交州，陈日烜空其城而遁。

translations.literal: Thereupon the great army advanced deep inland, reaching Jiaozhou; Chen Rixuan emptied the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The main army pushed inland to Jiaozhou, where Chen Rixuan evacuated the city and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 阿八赤曰：「贼弃巢穴而匿山海者，意待吾之敝而乘之耳。

translations.literal: Abaqi said: "The rebels have abandoned their nest and hidden in mountains and seas, intending to wait until we are exhausted and then strike.
translations.idiomatic: Abaqi said, "They left their capital and hid in the hills because they mean to wait until we are worn down, then hit us.

sentences.zh: 将士多北人，春夏之交瘴疠作，贼弗就擒，吾不能持久矣。

translations.literal: Most of the officers and soldiers are northerners; at the turn of spring and summer miasma breaks out. If the rebels are not captured, we cannot hold out long.
translations.idiomatic: Most of our men are northerners. Malaria rises in late spring and summer. If we do not catch the enemy soon we cannot stay.

sentences.zh: 今出兵分定其地，招降纳附，勿纵士卒侵掠，急捕日烜，此策之善者也。」

translations.literal: Now send out troops to secure the land in sections, summon surrender and receive submission, do not let soldiers plunder, and urgently capture Rixuan—this is the good strategy."
translations.idiomatic: Send troops to secure the country piece by piece, accept surrenders, forbid looting, and seize Rixuan quickly—that is the sound plan."

sentences.zh: 时日烜屡遣使约降，欲以赂缓我师。

translations.literal: At that time Rixuan repeatedly sent envoys to negotiate surrender, wishing to use bribes to delay our army.
translations.idiomatic: Rixuan kept sending envoys offering surrender, hoping bribes would slow our advance.

sentences.zh: 诸将皆信其说，且修城以居而待其至。

translations.literal: The generals all believed his words and moreover repaired the city to dwell in while awaiting his arrival.
translations.idiomatic: The generals believed him, repaired the city, and settled in to wait for him to come in.

sentences.zh: 久之，军乏食，日烜不降，拥众据竹洞、安邦海口。

translations.literal: After a long time the army lacked food; Rixuan did not surrender but gathered a host and held Zhudong and Anbang Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Time passed, supplies ran short, and Rixuan never surrendered. He massed troops at Zhudong and Anbang Harbor.

sentences.zh: 阿八赤率兵往攻之，屡与贼遇，昼夜迎战，贼兵败遁。

translations.literal: Abaqi led troops to attack them, repeatedly encountering the rebels, fighting day and night; the rebel army was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Abaqi marched against them, met the enemy again and again, and fought day and night until they broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 会将士多疫不能进，而诸蛮复叛，所得关厄皆失守，乃议班师。

translations.literal: Just then many officers and soldiers fell ill with epidemic and could not advance; moreover the various barbarians rebelled again, and the passes that had been taken were all lost—thereupon they discussed withdrawing the army.
translations.idiomatic: Then sickness swept the army and they could not advance. The tribal peoples rose again and every pass we had taken was lost, so withdrawal was debated.

sentences.zh: 选诸军步骑，命先启行，且战且行，日数十合。

translations.literal: He selected infantry and cavalry from the various armies, ordered them to set out first, fighting as they marched, with several dozen engagements a day.
translations.idiomatic: He picked infantry and cavalry from every unit to lead the march, fighting their way out with dozens of clashes each day.

sentences.zh: 贼据高险，射毒矢，将士裹疮以战，诸军护皇子出贼境，阿八赤中毒矢三，首项股皆肿，遂卒。

translations.literal: The rebels held the heights and shot poisoned arrows; officers and soldiers bound their wounds and fought. The various armies escorted the prince out of rebel territory. Abaqi was struck by three poisoned arrows; his head, neck, and thigh all swelled, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy held the high ground and shot poisoned arrows. Men fought on with bandaged wounds while the army escorted the prince out of hostile country. Abaqi took three poisoned arrows; his head, neck, and thigh swelled, and he died.

sentences.zh: 子寄僧，为水达达屯田总管府达鲁花赤。

translations.literal: His son Jiseng was Darughachi of the Udaida Military Colony Commission.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jiseng served as darughachi of the Udaida military colony commission.

sentences.zh: 乃颜叛，战于高丽双城。

translations.literal: When Nayan rebelled, [he] fought at Shuangcheng in Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: When Nayan rebelled he fought at Shuangcheng in Korea.

sentences.zh: 调万安军达鲁花赤。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Darughachi of Wan'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to be darughachi of Wan'an Army.

sentences.zh: 平黎蛮有功，迁雷州路总管，卒。

translations.literal: He had merit in pacifying the Li barbarians and was promoted to Circuit Intendant of Leizhou; he died.
translations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself pacifying the Li peoples, was promoted to intendant of Leizhou circuit, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 孙完者不花，同知潮州路总管府事；

translations.literal: His grandson Wanbuzhehua was Associate Intendant of the Chaozhou Circuit Intendancy;
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Wanbuzhehua was associate intendant of Chaozhou;

sentences.zh: 次秃满不花、也先不花、太不花。

translations.literal: next Tumanbuzhehua, Yexianbuzhehua, and Taibuzhehua.
translations.idiomatic: followed by Tumanbuzhehua, Yexianbuzhehua, and Taibuzhehua.

sentences.zh: ○纽璘也速答兒附

translations.literal: ○ Appendix: Niulin and Yesudai'er
translations.idiomatic: ○ Appendix: Niulin and Yesudai'er

sentences.zh: 纽璘，珊竹带人。

translations.literal: Niulin was a man of Shandudai.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin was from Shandudai.

sentences.zh: 祖孛罗带，为太祖宿卫，从太宗平金，戍河南。

translations.literal: His grandfather Boluodai served in Taizu's imperial guard, followed Taizong in pacifying Jin, and garrisoned Henan.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Boluodai had been in Taizu's guard, followed Taizong in the conquest of Jin, and garrisoned Henan.

sentences.zh: 父太答兒，佐宪宗征阿速、钦察等国有功，拜都元帅。

translations.literal: His father Tada'er assisted Emperor Xianzong in campaigns against the Alans, Cumans, and other states with merit, and was appointed Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: His father Tada'er served Emperor Xianzong in campaigns against the Alans and Cumans, earned distinction, and was made grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 岁壬子，率陕西西海、巩昌诸军攻宋，入蜀。

translations.literal: In the year renzi he led the armies of Shaanxi, Xihai, and Gongchang to attack Song and entered Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the renzi year he led Shaanxi, Xihai, and Gongchang troops against Song and entered Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，与总帅汪田哥立利州。

translations.literal: In guichou, together with Commander-in-Chief Wang Tiange, he established Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In guichou he and Commander Wang Tiange established Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，攻碉门、黎、雅等城。

translations.literal: In jiayin he attacked Diaomen, Li, Ya, and other cities.
translations.idiomatic: In jiayin he attacked Diaomen, Li, Ya, and other towns.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，入重庆，获都统制张实。

translations.literal: In yimao he entered Chongqing and captured Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shi.
translations.idiomatic: In yimao he took Chongqing and captured Song commander Zhang Shi.

sentences.zh: 是岁卒。

translations.literal: That year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died that same year.

sentences.zh: 纽璘伟貌长身，勇力绝人，且多谋略，常从父军中。

translations.literal: Niulin had a imposing appearance and tall stature; his courage and strength surpassed others, and he was also full of stratagems, often following his father in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin was tall and striking, possessed extraordinary strength, and was gifted in strategy. He often campaigned with his father.

sentences.zh: 丁巳岁，宪宗命将兵万人略地，自利州下白水，过大获山，出梁山军直抵夔门。

translations.literal: In the year dingsi Emperor Xianzong ordered him to lead ten thousand troops to raid territory, descending from Lizhou along the Baishui River, crossing Dahu Mountain, passing through Liangshan Army straight to Kuimen.
translations.idiomatic: In dingsi Emperor Xianzong gave him ten thousand men to raid enemy territory. He left Lizhou down the Baishui, crossed Dahu Mountain, passed Liangshan, and reached Kuimen.

sentences.zh: 戊午，还钓鱼山，引军欲会都元帅阿答胡等于成都。

translations.literal: In wuwu he returned to Diaoyu Mountain and led his army intending to join Grand Marshal Adahu and others at Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In wuwu he returned to Diaoyu Mountain and marched to join Grand Marshal Adahu at Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 宋制置使蒲择之，遣安抚刘整、都统制段元鉴等，率众据遂宁江箭滩渡以断东路。

translations.literal: Song Commissioner-in-Chief Pu Zezhi sent Pacification Commissioner Liu Zheng, Commander-in-Chief Duan Yuanjian, and others to lead a host and hold Jiangjian Ford on the Suining River to cut the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: Song commissioner Pu Zezhi sent Liu Zheng, Duan Yuanjian, and others to hold Jiangjian Ford on the Suining River and block the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 纽璘军至，不能渡，自旦至暮大战，斩首二千七百餘级，遂长驱至成都。

translations.literal: When Niulin's army arrived they could not cross; from dawn to dusk they fought a great battle, beheading more than twenty-seven hundred, and then drove straight on to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin's army arrived but could not cross. They fought from dawn to dusk, killed more than twenty-seven hundred men, and pushed on to Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 帝闻，赐金帛劳之。

translations.literal: The Emperor heard and bestowed gold and silk to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard and rewarded him with gold and silk.

sentences.zh: 蒲择之命杨大渊等守剑门及灵泉山，自将四川兵取成都。

translations.literal: Pu Zezhi ordered Yang Dayuan and others to guard Jianmen and Lingquan Mountain, while he personally led Sichuan troops to take Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Zezhi left Yang Dayuan to hold Jianmen and Lingquan Mountain and led Sichuan troops himself to retake Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 会阿答胡死，诸王阿卜干与诸将脱林带等谋曰：「今宋兵日逼，闻我帅死，必悉众来攻，其锋不可当。

translations.literal: It happened that Adahu died; Prince Abugan and the generals Tuolindai and others deliberated, saying: "Now Song troops press daily; hearing our commander is dead, they will surely muster all their forces to attack—their momentum cannot be withstood.
translations.idiomatic: Adahu died just then. Prince Abugan and generals including Tuolindai said, "Song pressure is growing daily. Once they hear our commander is dead they will throw everything at us, and we cannot meet that shock.

sentences.zh: 我军去朝廷远，待上命建大帅，然后御敌，恐无及已。

translations.literal: Our army is far from court; if we wait for imperial orders to appoint a grand commander and only then face the enemy, I fear it will be too late.
translations.idiomatic: We are far from court. Waiting for orders to appoint a new commander before we fight may be too late.

sentences.zh: 不若推纽璘为长，以号令诸将，出彼不意，敌可必破。」

translations.literal: It would be better to make Niulin leader to command the generals; catching the enemy off guard, they can surely be broken."
translations.idiomatic: Better to put Niulin in command. Surprise them and the enemy will surely break."

sentences.zh: 众然之，遂推纽璘为长。

translations.literal: All agreed, and thereupon they made Niulin leader.
translations.idiomatic: All agreed, and Niulin was chosen to lead.

sentences.zh: 璘率诸将大破宋军于灵泉山，乘胜追擒韩勇，斩之，蒲择之兵溃。

translations.literal: Lin led the generals to rout the Song army at Lingquan Mountain, pursued in victory to capture Han Yong and behead him; Pu Zezhi's troops collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin led the generals to a great victory at Lingquan Mountain, pursued and captured Han Yong and executed him, and Pu Zezhi's army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 进围云顶山城，扼宋军归路。

translations.literal: He advanced to besiege Yunding Mountain City, blocking the Song army's route of return.
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Yunding Mountain City and cut off the Song army's retreat.

sentences.zh: 其主将仓卒失计，遂以其众降。

translations.literal: Its commander, in haste and at a loss, thereupon surrendered with his host.
translations.idiomatic: The commander panicked, lost his bearings, and surrendered with his troops.

sentences.zh: 城中食尽，亦杀其守将以降。

translations.literal: When food in the city was exhausted, [the defenders] also killed their garrison commander to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When the city's food ran out the defenders killed their commander and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 成都、彭、汉、怀、绵等州悉平，威、茂诸蕃亦来附。

translations.literal: Chengdu, Peng, Han, Huai, Mian, and other prefectures were all pacified; the various tribes of Wei and Mao also came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Chengdu, Peng, Han, Huai, Mian, and other prefectures were pacified, and the Wei and Mao tribes submitted as well.

sentences.zh: 纽璘奉金银、竹箭、银销刀，遣速哥入献。

translations.literal: Niulin presented gold and silver, bamboo arrows, and silver-inlaid knives, sending Suke to enter and offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin sent gold and silver, bamboo arrows, and silver-inlaid knives to court through Suke.

sentences.zh: 帝赐黄金五十两，即军中真拜都元帅。

translations.literal: The Emperor bestowed fifty taels of gold and immediately in the army formally appointed him Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gave him fifty taels of gold and on the spot confirmed him as grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 时纽璘军止二万，以五千命拜延八都鲁等守成都，自将万五千人从马湖趋重庆。

translations.literal: At that time Niulin's army numbered only twenty thousand; he assigned five thousand under Bayan Badulu and others to guard Chengdu, and personally led fifteen thousand from Mahu toward Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin had only twenty thousand men. He left five thousand under Bayan Badulu to hold Chengdu and led fifteen thousand from Mahu toward Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 冬，帝进军至大获山，纽璘率步骑号五万，战船二百艘，发成都。

translations.literal: In winter the Emperor advanced his army to Dahu Mountain; Niulin led infantry and cavalry said to number fifty thousand and two hundred warships, setting out from Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the emperor advanced to Dahu Mountain. Niulin marched from Chengdu with a reported fifty thousand foot and horse and two hundred warships.

sentences.zh: 遣张威以五百人为前锋，水陆并进，谋锁重庆江，以绝吴、蜀之路，缚桥资州之口以济师。

translations.literal: He sent Zhang Wei with five hundred men as vanguard, advancing together by land and water, planning to block the Chongqing River to cut the routes between Wu and Shu, and building a bridge at the mouth of Zizhou to cross the army.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Zhang Wei with five hundred men as vanguard by land and water, planned to seal the Chongqing River and sever Wu-Shu communications, and bridged the Zizhou crossing for his army.

sentences.zh: 千户暗都剌率舟师而下，纽璘将步骑而南，旌旗辎重百里不绝，鼓噪渡泸，放舟而东。

translations.literal: Thousand-household commander Andula led the fleet downstream; Niulin led infantry and cavalry southward. Banners and baggage stretched unbroken for a hundred li; with clamorous drums they crossed the Lu River and set boats eastward.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand-household commander Andula took the fleet downstream while Niulin drove the army south. Supply trains stretched for a hundred li. With drums beating they crossed the Lu and sailed east.

sentences.zh: 蒲择之以兵分道要遮，遇辄败之。

translations.literal: Pu Zezhi sent troops by separate routes to intercept; whenever they met, [Niulin] defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Zezhi tried to block him on several roads; Niulin defeated every force he met.

sentences.zh: 纽璘至涪，造浮桥，驻军桥南北，以杜宋援兵。

translations.literal: Niulin reached Fu, built a pontoon bridge, and stationed troops north and south of the bridge to block Song relief.
translations.idiomatic: At Fu he built a pontoon bridge and camped on both banks to block Song reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 闻大军多虐疠，遣人进牛犬豕各万头。

translations.literal: Hearing that the great army suffered much from epidemic miasma, he sent men to present ten thousand head each of cattle, dogs, and pigs.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that the main army was ravaged by disease, he sent ten thousand cattle, dogs, and pigs as supplies.

sentences.zh: 明年春，朝行在所，还讨思、播二州，获其将一人。

translations.literal: The next spring he attended the mobile court, then returned to campaign against Si and Bo prefectures and captured one of their generals.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring he reported to the emperor's camp, then campaigned in Si and Bo and captured an enemy general.

sentences.zh: 宋将吕文焕攻涪浮桥，时新立成都，士马不耐其水土，多病死，纽璘忧之。

translations.literal: Song general Lü Wenhuan attacked the pontoon bridge at Fu. At that time Chengdu had just been established; troops and horses could not endure its climate and water, and many died of illness—Niulin was troubled.
translations.idiomatic: Song general Lü Wenhuan attacked the Fu bridge. Chengdu had only just been secured; men and horses sickened in the climate, and Niulin was deeply worried.

sentences.zh: 密旨督战，不得已出师，大败文焕军，获其将二人，斩之，遂班师。

translations.literal: By secret edict he was pressed to fight; with no choice he took the field, routed Wenhuan's army, captured two of his generals and beheaded them, and then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: A secret order forced him into battle. He routed Lü Wenhuan, captured two of his generals and executed them, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 文焕以兵袭其后，纽璘战却之。

translations.literal: Wenhuan struck at his rear with troops; Niulin fought and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wenhuan attacked his rear; Niulin turned and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 中统元年，世祖即位，纽璘入朝，赐虎符及黄金五十两、白金二千五百两、马二匹。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong, when Emperor Shizu took the throne, Niulin came to court and was bestowed a tiger tally, fifty taels of gold, twenty-five hundred taels of silver, and two horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 1, when Kublai took the throne, Niulin came to court and received a tiger tally, fifty taels of gold, twenty-five hundred taels of silver, and two horses.

sentences.zh: 纽璘遣梁载立招降黎、雅、碉门、岩州、偏林关诸蛮，得汉、番二万余户。

translations.literal: Niulin sent Liang Zaili to summon surrender among the various barbarians of Li, Ya, Diaomen, Yanzhou, and Pianlin Pass, gaining more than twenty thousand Han and tribal households.
translations.idiomatic: Niulin sent Liang Zaili to bring in the Li, Ya, Diaomen, Yanzhou, and Pianlin Pass tribes, winning more than twenty thousand Han and tribal households.

sentences.zh: 未几，诏速哥分西川兵及陕西诸军属纽璘，镇秦、巩、唐兀之地。

translations.literal: Before long an edict ordered Suke to assign the armies of western Sichuan and the various forces of Shaanxi to Niulin, who garrisoned the lands of Qin, Gong, and Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Suke was ordered to place western Sichuan and Shaanxi troops under Niulin, who garrisoned Qin, Gong, and Tangut territory.

sentences.zh: 三年，宋将刘整以泸州降，吕文焕围之，诏以兵往援，文焕败走，遂徙泸州民于成都、潼川。

translations.literal: In the third year Song general Liu Zheng surrendered Luzhou; Lü Wenhuan besieged it. An edict sent troops to relieve it; Wenhuan was defeated and fled, and the people of Luzhou were relocated to Chengdu and Tongchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Song general Liu Zheng surrendered Luzhou. Lü Wenhuan besieged the city until relief troops drove him off; Luzhou's people were then moved to Chengdu and Tongchuan.

sentences.zh: 四年，为刘整所谮，徵至上都，验问无状，诏释之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was slandered by Liu Zheng, summoned to the Upper Capital, examined and found without fault, and an edict released him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Liu Zheng slandered him. Summoned to the Upper Capital and investigated, he was cleared and released.

sentences.zh: 还至昌平，卒。

translations.literal: On his return he reached Changping and died.
translations.idiomatic: He died at Changping on the way back.

sentences.zh: 子也速答兒。

translations.literal: His son was Yesudai'er.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Yesudai'er.

sentences.zh: 也速答兒勇智类其父，至元十一年，入见世祖，以属行枢密院火都赤，使习兵事。

translations.literal: Yesudai'er's courage and wisdom resembled his father's. In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan he had audience with Emperor Shizu and was placed under Huoduchi of the Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs to study military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yesudai'er matched his father in courage and wit. In Zhiyuan 11 he was presented at court and assigned to Huoduchi of the mobile military bureau to learn campaigning.

sentences.zh: 从围嘉定，以三千人至三龟、九顶山相地形势，败宋安抚昝万寿兵，斩首五百级，以功赐虎符，授六翼达鲁花赤。

translations.literal: He followed the siege of Jiading; with three thousand men he went to Sangu and Jiuding mountains to survey the terrain, defeated the troops of Song Pacification Commissioner Zan Wanshou, beheaded five hundred, and for merit was bestowed a tiger tally and appointed Darughachi of the Six Wings.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege of Jiading he took three thousand men to scout Sangu and Jiuding mountains, defeated Song commissioner Zan Wanshou, killed five hundred men, and for this was given a tiger tally and made darughachi of the Six Wings.

sentences.zh: 昝万寿寻遣部将李立以嘉定、三龟、九顶、紫云诸城寨降。

translations.literal: Before long Zan Wanshou sent his subordinate general Li Li to surrender the fortified cities and stockades of Jiading, Sangu, Jiuding, and Ziyun.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Zan Wanshou sent his officer Li Li to surrender Jiading, Sangu, Jiuding, Ziyun, and the other strongholds.

sentences.zh: 又从行枢密副使忽敦率兵徇下流诸城，皆望风来附。

translations.literal: He again followed Mobile Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Hudun in leading troops to subdue the cities downstream; all submitted at the first report of his approach.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Vice Commissioner Hudun downriver; city after city submitted at his approach.

sentences.zh: 忽敦以兵二万会东川行枢密院合答围重庆，岁余不下，帝命行枢密副使不花代将。

translations.literal: Hudun led twenty thousand troops to join Heda of the Eastern Sichuan Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs in besieging Chongqing; after more than a year the city had not fallen, and the Emperor ordered Mobile Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs Buhua to replace him as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Hudun mustered twenty thousand men and joined Heda of the Eastern Sichuan mobile military bureau in the siege of Chongqing. More than a year passed without success, and the Emperor replaced Hudun with Vice Commissioner Buhua.

sentences.zh: 不花将兵万余至城下，也速答兒率二十餘骑攻其门。

translations.literal: Buhua led more than ten thousand troops to the foot of the city walls; Yesudai'er at the head of twenty-odd horsemen attacked its gate.
translations.idiomatic: Buhua brought more than ten thousand troops beneath the walls, and Yesudai'er led twenty-odd horsemen in an assault on the gate.

sentences.zh: 宋都统赵安出战，也速答兒三入其军，再挟猛士以出。

translations.literal: Song commander-in-chief Zhao An came out to fight; Yesudai'er thrice entered his army and twice seized fierce warriors and brought them out.
translations.idiomatic: Song commander Zhao An came out to fight; three times Yesudai'er rode into his ranks and twice seized fierce warriors and dragged them out alive.

sentences.zh: 大兵四集，斩首五百餘级。

translations.literal: When the main forces gathered on four sides, they beheaded more than five hundred.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army closed in from all sides, they took more than five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 赵安开门降，制置使张珏遁，追至涪州擒之。

translations.literal: Zhao An opened the gate and surrendered; Pacification Commissioner Zhang Yu fled; they pursued him to Fuzhou and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao An opened the gate and surrendered. Pacification Commissioner Zhang Yu fled but was pursued to Fuzhou and captured.

sentences.zh: 捷闻，帝赐玉带、钞五千贯，授西川蒙古军马六翼新附军招讨使，迁四川西道宣慰使，加都元帅。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, the Emperor bestowed a jade belt and five thousand strings of paper money, appointed him Pacification Commissioner of the Six Wings of Western Sichuan Mongol Cavalry and Newly Submitted Troops, transferred him to Pacification Commissioner of the Western Circuit of Sichuan, and added the title Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Word of the victory reached court; the Emperor gave him a jade belt and five thousand strings of paper money, made him pacification commissioner over the Six Wings of Western Sichuan Mongol cavalry and newly submitted troops, promoted him to pacification commissioner of Sichuan's western circuit, and added the rank of grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 罗氏鬼国亦奚不薛叛，诏以四川兵会雲南、江南兵讨之。

translations.literal: The Luoshi Ghost Country and Yixibuxi rebelled; an edict ordered Sichuan troops to join with Yunnan and Jiangnan troops to subdue them.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoshi Ghost Country and Yixibuxi rebelled, and an edict ordered Sichuan troops to join forces from Yunnan and Jiangnan to crush them.

sentences.zh: 至会灵关，亦奚不薛遣先锋阿麻、阿豆等将数万众迎敌，也速答兒驰入其军，挟阿麻、阿豆出，斩之。

translations.literal: When they reached Huiling Pass, Yixibuxi sent vanguard generals Ama, Adou, and others leading tens of thousands to meet the enemy; Yesudai'er galloped into their army, seized Ama and Adou and brought them out, and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: At Huiling Pass, Yixibuxi sent vanguard commanders Ama and Adou with tens of thousands to oppose them. Yesudai'er galloped into their ranks, seized Ama and Adou, brought them out, and executed them.

sentences.zh: 亦奚不薛惧，率所部五万余户降。

translations.literal: Yixibuxi was afraid and led more than fifty thousand households of his following to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Yixibuxi surrendered with more than fifty thousand households under his command.

sentences.zh: 以功拜西川等处行中书省右丞，加赐金帛鞍辔。

translations.literal: For his merit he was appointed Right Counsellor of the Western Sichuan and Other Regions Branch Secretariat, with an additional gift of gold, silks, saddle, and bridle.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was made right counsellor of the Western Sichuan branch secretariat and given gold, silk, a saddle, and bridle.

sentences.zh: 西南夷雄左、都掌蛮得兰右叛，诏以兵讨降之，改四川等处行枢密副使。

translations.literal: The southwestern Yi Xiongzuo and the Duzhang barbarian Delanyou rebelled; an edict ordered troops to subdue and accept their surrender, and he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Sichuan and Other Regions Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The southwestern Yi chieftain Xiongzuo and the Duzhang barbarian Delanyou rebelled. Troops were sent to quell them, and he was reassigned as vice commissioner of the Sichuan mobile military bureau.

sentences.zh: 冬，乌蒙蛮阴连都掌蛮以叛，诏以兵会雲南行院拜答力进讨。

translations.literal: In winter the Wumeng barbarians secretly joined the Duzhang barbarians in rebellion; an edict ordered troops to join with Bayadali of the Yunnan Mobile Bureau in advancing to attack.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Wumeng joined the Duzhang in a secret rebellion. An edict sent troops to join Bayadali of the Yunnan mobile bureau in a punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 也速答兒擒乌蒙蛮，帝赐玉带、织金服，迁蒙古军都万户，复赐银鼠裘，镇唐兀之地。

translations.literal: Yesudai'er captured the Wumeng barbarians; the Emperor bestowed a jade belt and brocade robe, transferred him to Grand Commander of the Mongol Army, again bestowed a silver-marten fur coat, and posted him to garrison the Tangut lands.
translations.idiomatic: Yesudai'er captured the Wumeng rebels. The Emperor gave him a jade belt and brocade robe, made him grand commander of the Mongol army, added a silver-marten fur coat, and posted him to garrison the Tangut frontier.

sentences.zh: 进同知四川等处行枢密院事，仍居镇。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Associate Commissioner of the Sichuan and Other Regions Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs while continuing to hold his post.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to associate commissioner of the Sichuan mobile military bureau while remaining at his post.

sentences.zh: 成宗即位，拜四川等处行中书省平章政事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Chengzong ascended the throne, he was appointed Left Counsellor of the Sichuan and Other Regions Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengzong took the throne, he was made left councillor of the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 武宗时，由四川迁雲南，加左丞相，仍为平章政事。

translations.literal: During Emperor Wuzong's reign he was transferred from Sichuan to Yunnan, given the additional title of Left Chancellor, and retained his post as Left Counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wuzong he moved from Sichuan to Yunnan, was given the added rank of left chancellor, and kept his councillor's post.

sentences.zh: 南征叛蛮，感瘴毒，还至成都卒。

translations.literal: On a southern campaign against rebel barbarians he contracted malarial poison and died on returning to Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: On a southern campaign against rebel tribes he succumbed to malaria and died at Chengdu on the return march.

sentences.zh: 弟八剌，袭为蒙古军万户。

translations.literal: His younger brother Bala succeeded to the post of Commander of Ten Thousand of the Mongol Army.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Bala inherited the command of ten thousand in the Mongol army.

sentences.zh: 八剌卒，次子拜延袭，拜四川行省左丞；

translations.literal: When Bala died, his second son Baiyan succeeded, and was appointed Left Counsellor of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: After Bala died, his second son Baiyan inherited the post and was appointed left counsellor of the Sichuan branch secretariat;

sentences.zh: 长子南加台，官至四川行省平章政事。

translations.literal: His eldest son Najatai rose to the post of Left Counsellor of the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Najatai rose to become left councillor of the Sichuan branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: ○阿剌罕

translations.literal: ○ Alahan
translations.idiomatic: ○ Alahan

sentences.zh: 阿剌罕，札剌兒氏。

translations.literal: Alahan was of the Jala'ir clan.
translations.idiomatic: Alahan was a Jala'ir Mongol.

sentences.zh: 祖拨彻，事太祖，为火而赤，又为博而赤，攻城掠地，数有战功。

translations.literal: His grandfather Boqche served the Taizu, was a huo'erchi and then a bo'erchi, captured cities and seized territory, and repeatedly won military merit.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Boqche served Taizu as a huo'erchi and later a bo'erchi, took cities and ground, and won repeated battlefield honors.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，仍以其职从征陇北、陕西，身先战士，死焉。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizong ascended the throne, he still held his post and followed the campaign in Longbei and Shaanxi, taking the lead among the warriors, and died there.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong took the throne, Boqche still held his post and followed the campaign into Longbei and Shaanxi. He led from the front and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 父也柳干，幼隶皇子岳里吉为卫士长。

translations.literal: His father Yeliugan, while young, was attached to Prince Yelügi as captain of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yeliugan entered service young as captain of the guard to Prince Yelügi.

sentences.zh: 岁乙未，从皇子阔出、忽都秃南征，累功授万户，迁天下马步禁军都元帅。

translations.literal: In the yiwei year he followed Princes Kuochu and Hudutu on the southern campaign; for accumulated merit he was granted the rank of Commander of Ten Thousand and promoted to Grand Marshal of the Empire's Cavalry and Infantry Forbidden Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the yiwei year he followed Princes Kuochu and Hudutu south. For repeated merit he was made commander of ten thousand and then grand marshal of the empire's horse and foot forbidden troops.

sentences.zh: 及大将察罕卒，也柳干领其职，拜诸翼军马都元帅，统大军攻淮东、西诸郡。

translations.literal: When the great general Chaghan died, Yeliugan took over his post, was appointed Grand Marshal of All Wings' Cavalry, and commanded a great army to attack the prefectures east and west of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: When the great general Chaghan died, Yeliugan took his command, was made grand marshal of all wings' horse troops, and led a great army against the Huai east and west.

sentences.zh: 戊午，战死扬州。

translations.literal: In the wuwu year he was killed in battle at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the wuwu year he was killed fighting at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 阿剌罕袭为诸翼蒙古军马都元帅。

translations.literal: Alahan succeeded to the post of Grand Marshal of All Wings' Mongol Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Alahan inherited command as grand marshal of all wings' Mongol cavalry.

sentences.zh: 己未，从世祖渡江，至鄂而还。

translations.literal: In the jiwei year he followed Emperor Shizu in crossing the Yangzi, reaching Ezhou before returning.
translations.idiomatic: In the jiwei year he followed Shizu across the Yangzi as far as Ezhou and then turned back.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，从至末黎伯颜孛剌。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, he followed him as far as Moli, Erbai Borijin.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu ascended the throne, Alahan followed him to Moli, Erbai Borijin.

sentences.zh: 宗王阿里不哥称兵内向，阿剌罕以所部军击破阿蓝带兒、浑都海之兵于昔门秃，追至河西，以功赐金五十两。

translations.literal: When the imperial prince Ariq Böke raised troops and marched inward, Alahan with his division defeated the armies of Alandai'er and Qundaqai at Ximentu, pursued them to Hexi, and for merit was bestowed fifty liang of gold.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Ariq Böke took up arms and marched south, Alahan routed the forces of Alandai'er and Qundaqai at Ximentu, pursued them into Hexi, and was rewarded with fifty liang of gold.

sentences.zh: 中统三年，李璮叛，据济南，大军讨之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong Li Tan rebelled, held Jinan, and a great army was sent to subdue him.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 3 Li Tan rebelled and seized Jinan; a great army was dispatched against him.

sentences.zh: 阿剌罕与璮战于老仓口，败之。

translations.literal: Alahan fought Tan at Laocangkou and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Alahan defeated Tan at Laocangkou.

sentences.zh: 璮伏诛，授都元帅，赐金虎符、银印。

translations.literal: Tan was executed; Alahan was appointed Grand Marshal and bestowed a gold tiger tally and silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: After Tan was executed, Alahan was made grand marshal and given a gold tiger tally and silver seal.

sentences.zh: 至元四年春，改上万户，从都元帅阿术伐宋。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year of Zhiyuan he was promoted to Commander of Ten Thousand Upper Rank and followed Grand Marshal Aju in attacking Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Zhiyuan 4 he was promoted to commander of ten thousand upper rank and followed Grand Marshal Aju against Song.

sentences.zh: 九月，师次襄阳西安阳滩，逆战宋兵，败之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the army halted at Xi'anyang Bank below Xiangyang, met Song troops in battle, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the army halted at Xi'anyang Bank below Xiangyang, met the Song in battle, and routed them.

sentences.zh: 五年，大军围襄樊，阿剌罕守南面百丈山、漫河滩，兵累交，宋不能师。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the great army besieged Xiangyang and Fancheng; Alahan held Baizhang Mountain and Manhe Bank on the south face; the armies repeatedly clashed and Song could not relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the great army besieged Xiangyang and Fancheng. Alahan held Baizhang Mountain and Manhe Bank on the southern front through repeated clashes, and the Song could not break the siege.

sentences.zh: 十年春，樊城破，襄阳降。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year Fancheng fell and Xiangyang surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 10 Fancheng fell and Xiangyang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十一年秋，丞相伯颜与阿术会师襄阳，遣阿剌罕率诸翼军攻郢、复诸州。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the eleventh year Chancellor Bayan and Aju joined forces at Xiangyang and sent Alahan to lead the wings' armies in attacking Ying, Fu, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of year 11 Chancellor Bayan and Aju joined at Xiangyang and dispatched Alahan with the wing armies to take Ying, Fu, and the other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十月，夺郢州南门堡。

translations.literal: In the tenth month they seized the South Gate fort of Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month they took the South Gate fort at Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丞相伯颜、阿术亲率骑兵行视汉阳城壁，欲取汉口渡江。

translations.literal: Chancellor Bayan and Aju personally led cavalry to inspect the walls of Hanyang, intending to cross the Yangzi at Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan and Aju personally led cavalry to inspect Hanyang's walls, planning to cross the Yangzi at Hankou.

sentences.zh: 宋人以精兵扼汉口，乃遣阿剌罕帅蒙古骑兵倍道兼行，击破沙芜堡，遂入江，取鄂州。

translations.literal: Song troops with elite forces blocked Hankou, so they dispatched Alahan to command Mongol cavalry by forced marches, broke through Shawu fort, then entered the river line and took Ezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Song elite troops held Hankou, so they sent Alahan with Mongol cavalry on forced marches. He broke Shawu fort, entered the river line, and took Ezhou.

sentences.zh: 阿剌罕同断事官杨仁风东略寿昌，得米四十万斛，遂统左翼军顺流东下，沿江州郡悉降，乃抚辑其人民。

translations.literal: Alahan together with judicial officer Yang Renfeng raided east into Shouchang, obtained four hundred thousand hu of rice, then commanded the left wing army downstream; all prefectures and commanderies along the river submitted, and he then pacified and settled their people.
translations.idiomatic: With judicial officer Yang Renfeng, Alahan raided east into Shouchang and seized four hundred thousand hu of rice. He then led the left wing downstream; every prefecture along the river submitted, and he set about pacifying the people.

sentences.zh: 十二年六月，加昭毅大将军、蒙古汉军上万户，屯驻建康。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twelfth year he was given the additional titles of Generalissimo of Manifest Valor and Commander of Ten Thousand Upper Rank of Mongol and Han Armies, and was stationed at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 12 he was made Generalissimo of Manifest Valor and commander of ten thousand upper rank over Mongol and Han troops, and encamped at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 丞相伯颜受诏赴阙，以阿剌罕留治省事，拜中奉大夫、参知政事。

translations.literal: Chancellor Bayan received an edict to proceed to court; Alahan was left to administer secretariat affairs and was appointed Grand Master of Palace Attendance and Assistant Administrator.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan was recalled to court; Alahan was left to run the secretariat and made assistant administrator with the rank of grand master of palace attendance.

sentences.zh: 丞相伯颜还军中，分军为三道并进。

translations.literal: When Chancellor Bayan returned to the army, the forces were divided into three routes and advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: When Bayan returned to the army, the force was split into three columns and advanced together.

sentences.zh: 阿剌罕由西道趋溧水、溧阳，攻破银树东坝，至护牙山庆丰圬，败宋军，斩首七千级，又擒其将祝亮，并裨校七十二人，斩首三千级。

translations.literal: Alahan by the western route pressed toward Lishui and Liyang, broke through the Yingshu East Dam, reached Qingfeng Wai at Huyashan, defeated Song troops, beheaded seven thousand, and also captured their general Zhu Liang together with seventy-two junior officers, beheading three thousand more.
translations.idiomatic: Alahan took the western route through Lishui and Liyang, broke the Yingshu East Dam, and at Huyashan's Qingfeng embankment routed the Song, taking seven thousand heads. He also captured general Zhu Liang and seventy-two subordinate officers, beheading three thousand more.

sentences.zh: 又与宋兵战，斩首七千级，逐其援兵退走数十里。

translations.literal: He again fought Song troops and beheaded seven thousand, driving their relief force back more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: He fought the Song again, taking seven thousand heads and driving their relief force back more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 又败其都统等三人，斩首三千级。

translations.literal: He again defeated three of their commanders-in-chief and beheaded three thousand.
translations.idiomatic: He again defeated three Song commanders-in-chief and took three thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 破建平县，杀其守吏。

translations.literal: He broke Jianping County and killed its defending officials.
translations.idiomatic: He overran Jianping County and killed its defending officials.

sentences.zh: 进攻广德军独松关。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Dusong Pass in Guangde Army.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed the attack on Dusong Pass in Guangde Army.

sentences.zh: 先是，宋广德守张濡杀国信使廉希贤、严忠范等于独松关，及阿剌罕军次安吉州上柏镇，濡率兵来拒战，大败之，斩首二千级，生擒其副将冯翼，戮于军前。

translations.literal: Previously Song defender of Guangde Zhang Ru had killed the imperial envoys Lian Xixian and Yan Zhongfan at Dusong Pass; when Alahan's army halted at Shangbai Town in Anji Prefecture, Ru led troops to resist; they were greatly defeated, two thousand beheaded, and his deputy general Feng Yi captured alive and executed before the army.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Guangde's defender Zhang Ru had killed the envoys Lian Xixian and Yan Zhongfan at Dusong Pass. When Alahan halted at Shangbai in Anji, Ru came out to fight and was crushed: two thousand heads were taken, and deputy Feng Yi was captured alive and executed before the ranks.

sentences.zh: 濡遁走，追斩之。

translations.literal: Ru fled; they pursued and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Ru fled; they pursued him and cut him down.

sentences.zh: 十三年春，宋以国降，诏阿剌罕同左丞董文炳率高兴等，攻浙东温、台、衢、婺、处、明、越及闽中诸郡，降其运使、提刑等五百人。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year Song surrendered the realm; an edict ordered Alahan together with Left Counsellor Dong Wenbing to lead Gao Xing and others in attacking Wen, Tai, Qu, Wu, Chu, Ming, Yue in eastern Zhejiang and the prefectures of Fujian, accepting the surrender of five hundred transport commissioners, judicial commissioners, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 13 the Song surrendered the realm. Alahan was ordered, with Left Counsellor Dong Wenbing, to lead Gao Xing and others against Wen, Tai, Qu, Wu, Chu, Ming, and Yue in eastern Zhejiang and the Fujian commanderies, accepting the surrender of five hundred transport and judicial officials.

sentences.zh: 追袭宋嗣秀王赵与ＢＴ至安福县，与ＢＴ以军三万来拒战，阿剌罕身先士卒，率高兴、撒里蛮等渡江，鏖战四十餘里，斩其步帅观察使李世达，生擒与ＢＴ及其将吏百八十人，悉斩之，获其铜印五、军资器仗无算。

translations.literal: Pursuing Song heir apparent Prince Zhao Yifu to Anfu County, Yifu came with thirty thousand troops to resist; Alahan led from the front, and with Gao Xing, Sariman, and others crossed the river; after fierce fighting for more than forty li they beheaded the infantry commander, Observer Li Shida, captured Yifu together with one hundred eighty of his officers and beheaded them all, and seized five bronze seals and incalculable military stores and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing Song Prince Xi Zhao Yifu to Anfu County, they met his army of thirty thousand. Alahan led from the front; with Gao Xing, Sariman, and others he crossed the river and fought fiercely for more than forty li. They killed infantry commander Li Shida, captured Zhao Yifu and one hundred eighty of his officers — all were executed — and took five bronze seals and countless arms and supplies.

sentences.zh: 泉州蒲寿庚降。

translations.literal: Quanzhou's Pu Shougen surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Shougen of Quanzhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 江南平，以参知政事佩金虎符，行江东宣慰使。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan was pacified, as Assistant Administrator wearing a gold tiger tally he served as Acting Pacification Commissioner of Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiangnan was pacified he served as acting pacification commissioner of Jiangdong, retaining his assistant administrator's rank and gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 十四年，入觐，进资善大夫、行中书省左丞，俄迁右丞，仍宣慰江东。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he had audience at court, was advanced to Grand Master for the Good of the Heir Apparent and Left Counsellor of the Branch Secretariat, soon transferred to Right Counsellor, and still pacified Jiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he went to court, was promoted to grand master for the good of the heir apparent and left counsellor of the branch secretariat, soon moved to right counsellor, and continued to oversee Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 十八年，召拜光禄大夫、中书左丞相、行中书省事，统蒙古军四十万征日本，行次庆元，卒于军中。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was summoned and appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, with charge of branch secretariat affairs, commanded four hundred thousand Mongol troops in the expedition against Japan, and died in the army when the march reached Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was summoned as grand master of splendid happiness and left chancellor of the central secretariat, with charge of branch secretariat affairs. He commanded four hundred thousand Mongol troops for the Japan expedition and died at Qingyuan on the march.

sentences.zh: 子拜降袭，累迁江浙行中书省平章政事，仍领本军万户。

translations.literal: His son Baijiang succeeded; through repeated promotions he rose to Left Counsellor of the Jiang-Zhe Branch Secretariat and still commanded his original army as Commander of Ten Thousand.
translations.idiomatic: His son Baijiang inherited the post, rose to left councillor of the Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat, and still commanded his hereditary ten-thousand.

sentences.zh: 拜降卒，弟也速迭兒袭，由左手蒙古军万户累迁河南江北行省平章政事，兼山东河北蒙古军大都督。

translations.literal: When Baijiang died, his younger brother Yesudie'er succeeded; from Commander of Ten Thousand of the Left-Hand Mongol Army he was repeatedly promoted to Left Counsellor of the Henan-Jiangbei Branch Secretariat and concurrently Grand Commander of the Shandong-Hebei Mongol Army.
translations.idiomatic: After Baijiang died, his younger brother Yesudie'er inherited the command. Starting as commander of ten thousand of the left-hand Mongol army, he rose to left councillor of the Henan-Jiangbei branch secretariat and grand commander of the Shandong-Hebei Mongol army.

sentences.zh: ○阿塔海 阿塔海，逊都思人。

translations.literal: ○ Atahai. Atahai was a native of the Xundusi people.
translations.idiomatic: ○ Atahai. Atahai was a Xundusi tribesman.

sentences.zh: 祖塔海拔都兒，骁勇善战，尝从太祖同饮黑河水，以功为千户。

translations.literal: His grandfather Tabai Badu'er was brave and skilled in battle; he once followed the Taizu in drinking together at the Black River waters and for merit was made Commander of a Thousand.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Tabai Badu'er was a fierce warrior. He once drank with Taizu at the Black River and was made commander of a thousand for his service.

sentences.zh: 父卜花袭职，卒。

translations.literal: His father Bohua succeeded to the post and died.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bohua inherited the post and died in office.

sentences.zh: 阿塔海魁伟有大度，才略过人。

translations.literal: Atahai was imposing in stature and magnanimous in bearing; his talent and strategy surpassed others.
translations.idiomatic: Atahai was imposing and magnanimous, with talent and strategy beyond ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 既袭千户，从大帅兀良合歹征雲南，身先行阵。

translations.literal: After succeeding to the command of a thousand, he followed the great commander Uriyangqadai in campaigning against Yunnan, putting himself at the head of the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: After inheriting his thousand, he followed Uriyangqadai against Yunnan and always placed himself at the head of the line.

sentences.zh: 师还，事世祖于潜邸。

translations.literal: When the army returned he served Emperor Shizu at the Hidden Residence.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he entered service with Shizu at the prince's residence.

sentences.zh: 至元九年，命驰驿督诸军攻襄阳。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Zhiyuan he was ordered to travel by relay post to supervise all armies attacking Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 9 he was ordered to ride relay post and direct all forces against Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 襄阳下，第功授镇国上将军、淮西行枢密院副使。

translations.literal: When Xiangyang fell, for ranked merit he was appointed General Superior in Stabilizing the State and Vice Commissioner of the Huai-West Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiangyang fell he was graded for merit and made general superior in stabilizing the state and vice commissioner of the Huai-West mobile military bureau.

sentences.zh: 筑正阳东西城。

translations.literal: He built the eastern and western cities of Zhengyang.
translations.idiomatic: He built the eastern and western citadels at Zhengyang.

sentences.zh: 五月霖雨，宋将夏贵乘淮水溢，来争正阳。

translations.literal: In the fifth month amid incessant rains Song general Xia Gui took advantage of the Huai River overflowing and came to contest Zhengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of heavy rains, Song general Xia Gui exploited the swollen Huai and came to contest Zhengyang.

sentences.zh: 阿塔海率众御之，贵走，追至安丰城下而还。

translations.literal: Atahai led the host to resist; Gui fled; they pursued to beneath the walls of Anfeng and then returned.
translations.idiomatic: Atahai met him in force; Gui fled, and they pursued to the walls of Anfeng before turning back.

sentences.zh: 拜中书右丞、行枢密院事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Right Counsellor of the Central Secretariat with charge of mobile bureau of military affairs affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed right counsellor of the central secretariat with charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 渡江，与丞相伯颜军合。

translations.literal: Crossing the Yangzi, he joined forces with Chancellor Bayan's army.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the Yangzi, he joined Bayan's army.

sentences.zh: 克池州。

translations.literal: He captured Chizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He took Chizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二年，师次建康。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the army halted at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12 the army halted at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 宋镇江摄守石祖忠遣使乞降。

translations.literal: Song acting defender of Zhenjiang Shi Zuzhong sent envoys begging to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zuzhong, acting defender of Zhenjiang, sent envoys offering surrender.

sentences.zh: 扬州守将李庭芝闻之，遣兵突围出击。

translations.literal: When Yangzhou's defending general Li Tingzhi heard of this, he sent troops to break out and strike.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, Yangzhou's defender Li Tingzhi sent troops to break out and attack.

sentences.zh: 阿塔海率师救之，宋兵望风退走。

translations.literal: Atahai led the army to relieve them; Song troops fled at the sight of his banners.
translations.idiomatic: Atahai marched to the rescue; the Song troops fled at his approach.

sentences.zh: 时真、泰诸城尚为宋守，镇江地扼襟喉，城壁不固，阿塔海乃立木栅，以保障居民。

translations.literal: At that time Zhen and Tai and other cities were still held by Song; Zhenjiang's terrain strangled a vital throat but its walls were not strong, so Atahai erected wooden palisades to protect the inhabitants.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Tai still held for the Song. Zhenjiang commanded a vital junction but its walls were weak, so Atahai put up wooden palisades to protect the people.

sentences.zh: 又分兵屯瓜洲，以绝扬州之援。

translations.literal: He also divided troops to encamp at Guazhou to cut off relief for Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He also posted troops at Guazhou to cut off relief for Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 宋将张世杰、孙虎臣帅舟师陈于江中焦山下，其势甚张，阿塔海与平章阿术登南岸督诸军大破之。

translations.literal: Song generals Zhang Shijie and Sun Huchen commanded a fleet and arrayed it below Jiaoshan in mid-river; their momentum was very imposing; Atahai together with Councillor Aju mounted the south bank to direct all armies and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Song generals Zhang Shijie and Sun Huchen anchored a fleet below Jiaoshan with great show of force. Atahai and Councillor Aju took the south bank and directed a crushing victory.

sentences.zh: 宋殿帅张彦与平江都统刘师勇袭吕城，遣万户怀都击之，斩彦。

translations.literal: Song palace guard commander Zhang Yan together with Pingjiang commander-in-chief Liu Shiyong raided Lucheng; he dispatched Commander of Ten Thousand Huaidu to strike them and beheaded Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Song palace guard Zhang Yan and Pingjiang commander Liu Shiyong raided Lucheng. Atahai sent Commander of Ten Thousand Huaidu against them and killed Yan.

sentences.zh: 十月，并行枢密院于行中书省，仍以阿塔海为右丞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs was merged with the Branch Secretariat, and Atahai was still appointed Right Counsellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the mobile military bureau was merged with the branch secretariat, and Atahai remained as right counsellor.

sentences.zh: 克常州，降平江、嘉兴。

translations.literal: He captured Changzhou and received the surrender of Pingjiang and Jiaxing.
translations.idiomatic: He took Changzhou and accepted the surrender of Pingjiang and Jiaxing.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，会兵临安，宋降，以其幼主、母后入觐。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year armies joined at Lin'an; Song surrendered, and the young ruler and empress dowager were brought to audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 13 the armies converged on Lin'an. Song surrendered, and the boy emperor and empress dowager were brought to court.

sentences.zh: 诏复趋瓜洲，与阿术议淮南事宜，淮南平。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him again to hasten to Guazhou; together with Aju he deliberated on Huainan affairs, and Huainan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered back to Guazhou; with Aju he settled Huainan affairs and pacified the region.

sentences.zh: 详见伯颜、阿术传。

translations.literal: Details are fully set forth in the biographies of Bayan and Aju.
translations.idiomatic: For fuller detail see the biographies of Bayan and Aju.

sentences.zh: 十四年，授荣禄大夫、平章政事、行中书省事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed Grand Master of Glorious Happiness, Councillor, with charge of branch secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he was made grand master of glorious happiness, councillor, with charge of branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月，召赴阙，拜光禄大夫、行中书省左丞相，移治临安。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year he was summoned to court, appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Left Chancellor of the Branch Secretariat, and moved his administration to Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 15 he was summoned to court as grand master of splendid happiness and left chancellor of the branch secretariat, and moved his seat of government to Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 二十年，迁征东行省丞相，征日本。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was transferred to Chancellor of the Eastern Expedition Branch Secretariat to campaign against Japan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 he was transferred to chancellor of the eastern expedition branch secretariat for the campaign against Japan.

sentences.zh: 遇风，舟坏，丧师十七、八。

translations.literal: They encountered wind; ships were wrecked and seventy or eighty percent of the army was lost.
translations.idiomatic: A storm wrecked the fleet and cost them seven or eight men in ten.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，行同知沿江枢密院事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he served as Acting Associate Commissioner of the Yangzi-Coast Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 he served as acting associate commissioner of the Yangzi-coast mobile military bureau.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，行江西中书省事，入朝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he served with charge of Jiangxi Central Secretariat affairs and entered court.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 he administered Jiangxi secretariat affairs and came to court.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，扈从征乃颜。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he followed the imperial procession on the campaign against Nayan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 24 he accompanied the emperor on the campaign against Nayan.

sentences.zh: 师还，奉朝请居京师。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was given the post of Court Gentleman for Attendance and resided in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he received court gentleman for attendance and lived in the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十六年十二月卒，年五十六，赠推忠翊运宣力功臣、开府仪同三司、太师、上柱国，追封顺昌郡王，谥武敏。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twenty-sixth year he died at age fifty-six; posthumously granted the title Meritorious Subject Who Extends Loyalty, Supports the Dynasty, and Exerts His Strength, with office equal to a grand general opening a government, Grand Preceptor, supreme pillar of the state; posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Shunchang Commandery; posthumous title Wumin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth month of year 26 at fifty-six. Posthumously he was titled meritorious subject who extends loyalty, supports the dynasty, and exerts his strength, with honors matching a generalissimo who opens a government, grand preceptor, and supreme pillar of the state; enfeoffed as Prince of Shunchang Commandery with the posthumous name Wumin.

sentences.zh: 子阿里麻，江淮行枢密副使，累官至江南诸道行御史臺御史大夫，卒。

translations.literal: His son Alima was Vice Commissioner of the Jiang-Huai Mobile Bureau of Military Affairs; through repeated promotions he rose to Censor-in-Chief of the Jiangnan All Circuits Mobile Censorate and died.
translations.idiomatic: His son Alima was vice commissioner of the Jiang-Huai mobile military bureau; he rose to become censor-in-chief of the Jiangnan mobile censorate and died.

sentences.zh: ○唆都百家奴

translations.literal: ○ Suodu Baijianu
translations.idiomatic: ○ Suodu Baijianu

sentences.zh: 唆都，扎剌兒氏。

translations.literal: Suodu was of the Jalair clan.
translations.idiomatic: Suodu belonged to the Jalair clan.

sentences.zh: 骁勇善战，入宿卫，从征花马国有功。

translations.literal: Bold and skilled in battle, he entered the imperial guard and achieved merit on the campaign against the Huama kingdom.
translations.idiomatic: Fierce and expert in war, he joined the imperial guard and won distinction campaigning against Huama.

sentences.zh: 李璮叛山东，从诸王哈必赤平之。

translations.literal: When Li Tan rebelled in Shandong, he followed Prince Habbichi to pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Tan rebelled in Shandong, he served under Prince Habbichi in putting down the revolt.

sentences.zh: 还，言于朝曰：「郡县恶少年，多从间道鬻马于宋境，乞免其罪，籍为兵。」

translations.literal: On his return he addressed the court, saying: "In the prefectures and counties many bad youths secretly sell horses in Song territory by hidden paths. I beg that their crimes be pardoned and that they be registered as soldiers."
translations.idiomatic: After returning he told the court, "Across the prefectures and counties, dissolute young men often slip along back trails to sell horses inside Song territory. I ask that their offenses be waived and they be enrolled as troops."

sentences.zh: 从之，得兵三千人。

translations.literal: The request was granted, and three thousand soldiers were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed, yielding three thousand men.

sentences.zh: 以千人隶唆都，为千户，命守蔡州。

translations.literal: One thousand men were placed under Suodu's command as a thousand-household unit, and he was ordered to garrison Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand of them were assigned to Suodu as a qianhu command; he was ordered to hold Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 至元五年，阿术等兵围襄阳，命唆都出巡逻，夺宋金刚台寨、筲基窝、青涧寨、大洪山、归州洞诸隘。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan, when Aju and others besieged Xiangyang, Suodu was ordered out on patrol and seized the Song strongpoints Jingangtai Stockade, Shaojiwo, Qingjian Stockade, Dahong Mountain, and Guizhou Cave, among other passes.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 5, as Aju's forces besieged Xiangyang, Suodu was sent on patrol and took the Song outposts at Jingangtai, Shaojiwo, Qingjian, Dahong Mountain, Guizhou Cave, and other passes.

sentences.zh: 尝猝遇宋兵千餘，持羁勒欲窃马，唆都战败之，斩首三百级。

translations.literal: Once he suddenly encountered more than a thousand Song troops bearing bridles and intent on stealing horses; Suodu defeated them and took three hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: He once ran into more than a thousand Song soldiers armed with bridles, bent on horse theft; Suodu routed them and cut down three hundred men.

sentences.zh: 六年，宋将范文虎率舟师驻灌子滩，丞相史天泽命唆都拒却之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Song general Fan Wenhu led a fleet and encamped at Guanzitan; Chancellor Shi Tianze ordered Suodu to repulse him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the Song general Fan Wenhu anchored a fleet at Guanzitan; Chancellor Shi Tianze sent Suodu to drive him off.

sentences.zh: 升总管，分东平卒八百隶之。

translations.literal: He was promoted to commander-in-chief, and eight hundred troops from Dongping were assigned to him.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to zongguan, he was given eight hundred men from the Dongping garrison.

sentences.zh: 九年，攻樊城，唆都先登，城遂破。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, attacking Fancheng, Suodu was first to ascend the wall, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9, assaulting Fancheng, Suodu led the climb; the city fell.

sentences.zh: 襄阳降，再与卒五千，赐弓矢、袭衣、金鞍、白金等物。

translations.literal: When Xiangyang surrendered, he was given another five thousand troops and granted bows and arrows, court robes, a gold saddle, white silver, and other gifts.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiangyang capitulated he received five thousand more troops, along with bows and arrows, ceremonial dress, a gold saddle, silver, and other rewards.

sentences.zh: 入见，升郢复等处招讨使。

translations.literal: On entering audience he was promoted to Pacification Commissioner for Ying, Fu, and other regions.
translations.idiomatic: Called to court, he was made pacification commissioner for Ying, Fu, and neighboring districts.

sentences.zh: 十一年，移戍郢州之高港，败宋师，斩首三百级，获裨校九人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he moved to garrison Gaogang in Ying Prefecture, defeated a Song army, took three hundred heads, and captured nine junior officers.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 he shifted his garrison to Gaogang in Yingzhou, beat a Song force, killed three hundred, and took nine officers prisoner.

sentences.zh: 从大军济江，鄂、汉降。

translations.literal: Following the great army across the Yangzi, E and Han surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Marching with the main force across the river, he helped bring Ezhou and Hankou to submission.

sentences.zh: 十二年，建康降，参政塔出命唆都入城招集，改建康安抚使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, when Jiankang surrendered, Vice Administrator Tachu ordered Suodu to enter the city to gather the people and made him Jiankang Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12, after Jiankang surrendered, Vice Administrator Tachu sent Suodu in to rally the populace and appointed him Jiankang pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 攻平江、嘉兴，皆下之。

translations.literal: Attacking Pingjiang and Jiaxing, he captured them both.
translations.idiomatic: He took Pingjiang and Jiaxing in turn.

sentences.zh: 帅舟师会伯颜于阜亭山。

translations.literal: He led the fleet to join Bayan at Futing Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded the river force to rendezvous with Bayan at Mount Futing.

sentences.zh: 宋平，诏伯颜以宋主入朝，留参政董文炳守临安，令其自择可副者，文炳请留唆都，从之。

translations.literal: When Song was pacified, an edict ordered Bayan to bring the Song ruler to court, leaving Vice Administrator Dong Wenbing to hold Lin'an and choose his own deputy; Wenbing asked that Suodu remain, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: With Song subdued, the court ordered Bayan to escort the Song emperor north and left Dong Wenbing as vice administrator at Lin'an, free to pick a deputy; Wenbing asked for Suodu, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 时衢、婺诸州皆复起兵，文炳谓唆都曰：「严州不守，临安必危，公往镇之。」

translations.literal: At that time Qu, Wu, and other prefectures had all risen again in arms; Wenbing said to Suodu: "If Yanzhou is not held, Lin'an will be in peril — you must go and secure it."
translations.idiomatic: Qu, Wu, and other prefectures were in revolt again. Wenbing told Suodu, "If Yanzhou falls, Lin'an is finished — go and hold the line there."

sentences.zh: 至严方十日，衢、婺、徽连兵来攻，唆都战却之，获章知府等二十二人。

translations.literal: Ten days after he reached Yanzhou, combined forces from Qu, Wu, and Hui came to attack; Suodu fought them off and captured Prefect Zhang and twenty-one others.
translations.idiomatic: He had been at Yanzhou only ten days when allied troops from Qu, Wu, and Hui attacked; Suodu beat them back and took Prefect Zhang and twenty-one others.

sentences.zh: 复婺州，败宋将陈路钤于梅岭下，斩首三千级。

translations.literal: He recovered Wuzhou, defeated Song commander Supervisor Chen at the foot of Meiling Pass, and took three thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: He restored Wuzhou, shattered Song Supervisor Chen below Meiling, and left three thousand dead.

sentences.zh: 又复龙游县。

translations.literal: He also recovered Longyou County.
translations.idiomatic: He recovered Longyou County as well.

sentences.zh: 攻衢州，衢守备甚严，唆都亲率诸军鼓噪登城，拔之，宋丞相留梦炎降。

translations.literal: Attacking Quzhou, the defenders were very strict; Suodu personally led all the armies, shouting as they scaled the walls and stormed it; Song Chancellor Liu Mengyan surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Quzhou was tightly held, but Suodu personally led his troops up the walls in a roaring assault and took the city; Song Chancellor Liu Mengyan submitted.

sentences.zh: 攻处州，斩首七百级。

translations.literal: Attacking Chuzhou, he took seven hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Assaulting Chuzhou, he killed seven hundred.

sentences.zh: 又攻建宁府松溪县、怀安县，皆下之。

translations.literal: He also attacked Songxi and Huai'an counties in Jianning Prefecture and captured them both.
translations.idiomatic: He also took Songxi and Huai'an in Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十四年，升福建道宣慰使，行征南元帅府事，听参政塔出节制。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was promoted to Pacification Commissioner of the Fujian Circuit, with charge of the Southern Campaign Marshal's headquarters, subject to Vice Administrator Tachu's command.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 he was made Fujian circuit pacification commissioner, acting head of the southern campaign marshal's headquarters under Vice Administrator Tachu.

sentences.zh: 塔出令唆都取道泉州，泛海会于广州之富场。

translations.literal: Tachu ordered Suodu to go by way of Quanzhou and sail the sea to rendezvous at Fuchang in Guangzhou.
