translations.idiomatic: Tachu ordered Suodu to march via Quanzhou and put to sea for a rendezvous at Fuchang, near Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 将行，信州守臣来求援曰：「元帅不来，信不可守。

translations.literal: Before departing, Xin Prefecture's officials came begging aid, saying: "If the marshal does not come, Xin cannot be held.
translations.idiomatic: As he was about to leave, Xinzhou's defenders came pleading: "Without the marshal, Xinzhou cannot stand.

sentences.zh: 今邵武方聚兵观衅，元帅旦往，邵武兵夕至矣。」

translations.literal: Shaowu is now gathering troops and watching for an opening; if the marshal goes there at dawn, Shaowu troops will arrive by evening."
translations.idiomatic: Shaowu is massing troops and waiting for a chance to strike; if you reach there at dawn, their forces will be on us by nightfall."

sentences.zh: 唆都告于众曰：「若邵武不下，则腹背受敌，岂独信不可守乎！」

translations.literal: Suodu told the assembled troops: "If Shaowu is not taken, we will be attacked front and rear — will Xin alone be defensible?"
translations.idiomatic: Suodu told his officers, "If we leave Shaowu standing, we'll be caught between two fires — Xinzhou won't be the only place we can't hold."

sentences.zh: 乃遣周万户等往招降之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he dispatched Commander Zhou and others to summon them to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Commander Zhou and others to offer terms.

sentences.zh: 唆都趋建宁，遇宋兵于崇安，军容甚盛。

translations.literal: Suodu hurried toward Jianning and encountered Song troops at Chong'an; their formation was very imposing.
translations.idiomatic: Suodu pressed toward Jianning and met a Song army at Chong'an in full battle array.

sentences.zh: 令其子百家奴及杨庭璧等数队夹击之，范万户以三百人伏祝公桥，移剌答以四百人伏北门外。

translations.literal: He ordered his son Baijianu and Yang Tingbi and several other columns to attack from both sides; Commander Fan lay in ambush at Zhugong Bridge with three hundred men, and Yelü Da with four hundred men outside the north gate.
translations.idiomatic: He sent his son Baijianu and Yang Tingbi with several columns to hit them from both flanks, while Commander Fan hid three hundred men at Zhugong Bridge and Yelü Da four hundred outside the north gate.

sentences.zh: 庭璧陷阵深入，宋兵败走，伏兵起，邀击之，斩首千餘级。

translations.literal: Tingbi plunged deep into the enemy lines; the Song army was defeated and fled; the ambush rose and intercepted them, taking more than a thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: Tingbi drove deep into the enemy line; the Song force broke and ran, and the ambush sprang up to cut them down — more than a thousand dead.

sentences.zh: 宋丞相文天祥、南剑州都督张清合兵将袭建宁，唆都夜设伏败之。

translations.literal: Song Chancellor Wen Tianxiang and Nanjian Prefecture commander Zhang Qing combined forces and were about to strike Jianning; Suodu set an ambush by night and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Song Chancellor Wen Tianxiang and Nanjian commander Zhang Qing joined forces to strike Jianning; Suodu laid a night ambush and routed them.

sentences.zh: 转战至南剑，败张清，夺其城。

translations.literal: Fighting on to Nanjian, he defeated Zhang Qing and seized his city.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the fight to Nanjian, he beat Zhang Qing and took the city.

sentences.zh: 至福州，王积翁以城降。

translations.literal: Reaching Fuzhou, Wang Jiweng surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuzhou, Wang Jiweng handed over the city.

sentences.zh: 攻兴化军，知军陈瓚乞降，复闭城拒守。

translations.literal: Attacking Xinghua Commandery, commander Chen Zhan begged to surrender but then shut the gates and continued to resist.
translations.idiomatic: At Xinghua Commandery, Commander Chen Zhan asked to surrender, then shut the gates and held out.

sentences.zh: 唆都临城谕之，矢石雨下。

translations.literal: Suodu approached the walls to persuade them, but arrows and stones rained down.
translations.idiomatic: Suodu rode up to the walls to parley; arrows and stones poured down like rain.

sentences.zh: 乃造云梯砲石，攻破其城。

translations.literal: Thereupon he built siege towers and stone projectiles and broke the city.
translations.idiomatic: He built siege towers and catapults and stormed the walls.

sentences.zh: 巷战终日，斩首三万余级，获瓚，支解以徇。

translations.literal: Street fighting lasted the whole day; more than thirty thousand heads were taken; Zhan was captured and dismembered as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Street fighting raged all day; more than thirty thousand were killed. Chen Zhan was taken, cut limb from limb, and displayed as a warning.

sentences.zh: 至漳州，漳州亦拒守，先遣百家奴往会塔出，留攻之，斩首数千级，知府何清降。

translations.literal: At Zhangzhou, which also resisted, he first sent Baijianu to join Tachu, remained to attack it, took several thousand heads, and Prefect He Qing surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzhou also held out. Suodu sent Baijianu ahead to join Tachu while he stayed to press the siege, killing several thousand before Prefect He Qing submitted.

sentences.zh: 攻潮州，知府马发不降，唆都恐失富场之期，乃舍之而去。

translations.literal: Attacking Chaozhou, Prefect Ma Fa would not surrender; Suodu, fearing he would miss the rendezvous at Fuchang, abandoned it and departed.
translations.idiomatic: At Chaozhou, Prefect Ma Fa refused to yield. Afraid of missing the Fuchang rendezvous, Suodu broke off and moved on.

sentences.zh: 十五年，至广州，塔出令还攻潮。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, reaching Guangzhou, Tachu ordered him to return and attack Chao.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 he reached Guangzhou; Tachu ordered him back to take Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 发城守益备，唆都塞堑填濠，造云梯、鹅车，日夜急攻。

translations.literal: Fa's defenses grew tighter; Suodu filled moats and ditches, built siege ladders and goose carts, and pressed the attack day and night.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Fa tightened the defense. Suodu filled ditches and moats, built siege ladders and covered assault carts, and hammered the walls day and night.

sentences.zh: 发潜遣人焚之，二十餘日不能下，唆都令于众曰：「有能先登者拜爵，已仕者增秩。」

translations.literal: Fa secretly sent men to burn them; after more than twenty days the city could not be taken; Suodu announced to the troops: "Whoever is first to ascend shall be ennobled; those already in office shall receive higher rank."
translations.idiomatic: Ma Fa sent men to burn the engines by night. After more than twenty fruitless days, Suodu promised the troops: "Whoever scales the wall first wins a noble title; serving officers get a promotion."

sentences.zh: 总管兀良哈耳先登，诸将继之，战至夕，宋兵溃，潮州平。

translations.literal: Commander Uriangqadai was first to ascend; the generals followed; fighting lasted until evening; the Song troops broke; Chaozhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Uriangqadai went up first; the other officers followed. By evening the Song line had collapsed and Chaozhou was taken.

sentences.zh: 进参知政事，行省福州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Administrator with the branch secretariat at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice administrator and given charge of the Fuzhou branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 征入见，帝以江南既定，将有事于海外，升左丞，行省泉州，招谕南夷诸国。

translations.literal: Summoned to audience, the Emperor, seeing that the Jiangnan region was settled and intending affairs overseas, promoted him to Left Vice Chancellor with the branch secretariat at Quanzhou to summon and persuade the southern barbarian kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: Called to court, the Emperor — with Jiangnan pacified and overseas campaigns in view — made him left vice chancellor at Quanzhou to summon the southern kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 十八年，改右丞，行省占城。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was changed to Right Vice Chancellor with the branch secretariat at Champa.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 he was reassigned as right vice chancellor with the Champa branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十九年，率战船千艘，出广州，浮海伐占城。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he led a thousand warships out of Guangzhou and sailed the sea to campaign against Champa.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he put a thousand warships to sea from Guangzhou and invaded Champa.

sentences.zh: 占城迎战，兵号二十万。

translations.literal: Champa met them in battle; their army was claimed to number two hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Champa came out to fight with an army said to number two hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 唆都率敢死士击之，斩首并溺死者五万余人。

translations.literal: Suodu led dare-to-die soldiers against them; heads taken and men drowned totaled more than fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Suodu led his shock troops into the fight; killed and drowned, the enemy lost more than fifty thousand.

sentences.zh: 又败之于大浪湖，斩首六万级。

translations.literal: He again defeated them at Dalang Lake and took sixty thousand heads.
translations.idiomatic: He routed them again at Dalang Lake, leaving sixty thousand dead.

sentences.zh: 占城降，唆都造木为城，辟田以耕。

translations.literal: Champa surrendered; Suodu built fortifications of wood and opened fields for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Champa submitted. Suodu threw up wooden fortifications and opened land for farming.

sentences.zh: 伐乌里、越里诸小夷，皆下之，积谷十五万以给军。

translations.literal: Campaigning against the small barbarian peoples of Wuli, Yueli, and others, he subdued them all and accumulated one hundred fifty thousand units of grain to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: He subdued the minor peoples of Wuli, Yueli, and the rest, and stockpiled one hundred fifty thousand measures of grain for the troops.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，镇南王脱欢征交趾，诏唆都帅师来会，败交趾兵于清化府，夺义安关，降其臣彰宪、昭显。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, when the Prince of Zhennan Toqan campaigned against Jiaozhi, an edict ordered Suodu to lead his army to join him; he defeated Jiaozhi troops at Thanh Hóa Prefecture, seized the Nghệ An Pass, and received the submission of ministers Zhang Xian and Zhao Xian.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 Prince of Zhennan Toqan marched on Annam; Suodu was ordered to join him, routed Annamese forces at Thanh Hóa, took Nghệ An Pass, and won over ministers Zhang Xian and Zhao Xian.

sentences.zh: 脱欢命唆都屯天长以就食，与大营相距二百餘里。

translations.literal: Toqan ordered Suodu to encamp at Thiên Trường to draw provisions, more than two hundred li from the main camp.
translations.idiomatic: Toqan posted Suodu at Thiên Trường to live off local supplies, more than two hundred li from the main army.

sentences.zh: 俄有旨班师，脱欢引兵还，唆都不知也。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered withdrawal; Toqan led the troops back, and Suodu did not know.
translations.idiomatic: An order to withdraw came suddenly. Toqan marched back — and Suodu knew nothing of it.

sentences.zh: 交趾使人告之，弗信，及至大营，则空矣。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi sent envoys to tell him, but he did not believe; when he reached the main camp, it was empty.
translations.idiomatic: Annam sent word, but he refused to believe it — and when he reached the main camp, it was deserted.

sentences.zh: 交趾遮之于乾满江，唆都战死。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi intercepted him at the Ganman River, and Suodu died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Annam cut him off at the Ganman River, and Suodu was killed in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 事闻，赠荣禄大夫，谥襄愍。

translations.literal: When the report reached court, he was posthumously granted the title Grand Master of Glorious Emolument and given the posthumous name Xiangmin.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached court he was posthumously made grand master of glorious emolument, with the posthumous name Xiangmin.

sentences.zh: 子百家奴。

translations.literal: His son was Baijianu.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Baijianu.

sentences.zh: 百家奴至元五年从元帅阿术攻襄阳，筑新城，数立功。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan Baijianu followed Marshal Aju in attacking Xiangyang, built the new city, and repeatedly achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 5 Baijianu served under Marshal Aju at the siege of Xiangyang, helped build the new fortifications, and won repeated distinction.

sentences.zh: 七年，以质子从郡王合达，败宋兵于灌子滩。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, serving as a hostage-attendant with Prince Heda, he defeated Song troops at Guanzitan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7, attached as a hostage-attendant to Prince Heda, he helped defeat Song forces at Guanzitan.

sentences.zh: 八年夏四月，宋殿帅范文虎等督促粮运，输之襄阳，昼夜不绝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the eighth year, Song marshal Fan Wenhu and others urged on grain transport, shipping it to Xiangyang day and night without cease.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 8, Song Marshal Fan Wenhu and others drove grain convoys to Xiangyang without pause, day and night.

sentences.zh: 百家奴乘战船顺流至鹿门山，欲塞宋粮道，出击范文虎军，累获战功，于是河南行省命为管军总把。

translations.literal: Baijianu took war vessels downstream to Lumen Mountain, intending to block the Song grain route; sallying out he struck Fan Wenhu's army and repeatedly won battle honors; thereupon the Henan Branch Secretariat appointed him commander of army zongba.
translations.idiomatic: Baijianu sailed downstream to Lumen Mountain to choke the Song supply line, sallied against Fan Wenhu's force, and piled up victories until the Henan branch secretariat made him zongba commander.

sentences.zh: 后隶丞相伯颜麾下，擢为知印。

translations.literal: Later he was placed under Chancellor Bayan and promoted to seal keeper.
translations.idiomatic: He later served under Chancellor Bayan and was promoted to seal keeper.

sentences.zh: 从攻鄂州，宋都统赵五帅诸军来迎战，百家奴深入却敌，身被数疮。

translations.literal: Following the attack on E Prefecture, Song commander-in-chief Zhao Wu led the armies to meet battle; Baijianu plunged deep and repelled the enemy, his body receiving several wounds.
translations.idiomatic: At the assault on Ezhou, Song commander-in-chief Zhao Wu came out to fight; Baijianu drove deep into the enemy line and drove them back, taking several wounds.

sentences.zh: 攻沙洋，立云梯于东角楼，登城力战，破之，夺其旗帜、弓矢、衣甲。

translations.literal: Attacking Shayang, he set a siege ladder at the east corner tower, ascended the wall and fought fiercely, broke it, and seized flags, bows and arrows, and armor.
translations.idiomatic: At Shayang he raised a siege ladder against the east corner tower, fought his way onto the wall, took the place, and captured flags, bows, and armor.

sentences.zh: 攻新城，先登，拔之，宋将王安抚弃城宵遁。

translations.literal: Attacking the new city, he was first to ascend and storm it; Song commander Pacification Commissioner Wang abandoned the city and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: At the new fort he was first over the wall and took it; Song Pacification Commissioner Wang abandoned the city and fled in the night.

sentences.zh: 伯颜以百家奴前后战功上闻，世祖大悦，曰：「此人之名，朕心不忘，兵还时大用之，朕不食言也。

translations.literal: Bayan reported Baijianu's repeated battle honors to the throne; Emperor Shizu was greatly pleased and said: "This man's name I shall not forget from my heart; when the army returns I shall employ him greatly — I do not break my word.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan reported Baijianu's record to the throne. Kublai was delighted and said, "I will not forget this man's name. When the army returns I mean to use him well — and I do not break my word.

sentences.zh: 今且以良家女及银碗一赐之，以为左验。」

translations.literal: For now let a woman of good family and one silver bowl be granted him as a token."
translations.idiomatic: For now give him a woman of good family and a silver bowl as a pledge of what is to come."

sentences.zh: 从围汉阳，自沙武口曳船入江。

translations.literal: He followed the siege of Hanyang, dragging boats from Shawukou into the river.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the siege of Hanyang and hauled boats from Shawukou into the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 宋制置夏贵来迎战，百家奴与暗答孙突入敌阵击之，宋兵奔溃，遂登江南岸，获其战船、器甲甚多。

translations.literal: Song commander-in-chief Xia Gui came to meet battle; Baijianu and Andasun burst into the enemy formation and struck them; the Song troops fled in rout; they then reached the south bank of the Jiang and seized a great many war vessels and armor.
translations.idiomatic: Song commander-in-chief Xia Gui came out to fight. Baijianu and Andasun plunged into the enemy line and broke them; the Song force scattered. They crossed to the south bank and captured a great haul of ships and armor.

sentences.zh: 转战至黄州，会日暮，追击夏贵至白虎山，夜分乃还。

translations.literal: Fighting on to Huang Prefecture, as night fell he pursued Xia Gui to Baihu Mountain and returned only at midnight.
translations.idiomatic: The fighting carried to Huangzhou. At dusk he chased Xia Gui to Mount Baihu and did not return until midnight.

sentences.zh: 未几，复攻破金牛坝。

translations.literal: Before long he again broke through Jinniuba.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he took Jinniuba as well.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月，与千户薛赤干取鸡笼洞，还至瑞昌县，遇夏贵溃兵，复击败之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the twelfth year, together with qianhu Xue Chigan he took Jilong Cave; returning to Ruichang County he encountered Xia Gui's routed troops and again defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 12 he and Qianhu Xue Chigan took Jilong Cave; on the march back through Ruichang they ran into Xia Gui's broken troops and beat them again.

sentences.zh: 是时，宋遣兵救瑞昌，未至而县已下矣。

translations.literal: At that time Song dispatched troops to relieve Ruichang, but before they arrived the county had already fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Song had sent relief for Ruichang, but the county fell before they arrived.

sentences.zh: 复击宋救兵，得宋所执北兵五人来归。

translations.literal: He again struck the Song relief troops and recovered five northern soldiers whom Song held, who returned to the Yuan side.
translations.idiomatic: He hit the Song relief column again and recovered five Yuan soldiers whom Song had taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 围江州，宋安抚吕师夔以城降。

translations.literal: Besieging Jiang Prefecture, Song Pacification Commissioner Lü Shiqing surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiangzhou, Song Pacification Commissioner Lü Shiqing surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 东定池州，击宋平章贾似道及孙虎臣于丁家洲，追逐百里餘，夺战船五艘及旗帜器甲，擒宋统制王文虎，因定黄池。

translations.literal: Pacifying Chizhou to the east, he struck Song Councillor Jia Sidao and Sun Huchen at Dingjiazhou, pursued more than a hundred li, seized five war vessels along with flags and armor, captured Song commander Wang Wenhu, and thereby settled Huangchi.
translations.idiomatic: He secured Chizhou to the east and met Song Councillor Jia Sidao and Sun Huchen at Dingjiazhou, chasing them more than a hundred li, taking five warships with their flags and gear, capturing Song commander Wang Wenhu, and pacifying Huangchi.

sentences.zh: 略地宣州，百家奴为前锋，与敌兵战喃呢湖，败之，夺其战船三百艘。

translations.literal: Raising lands in Xu Prefecture, Baijianu served as vanguard; fighting the enemy at Nanni Lake, he defeated them and seized three hundred war vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Raising Xu Prefecture, Baijianu led the van and routed the enemy at Nanni Lake, capturing three hundred warships.

sentences.zh: 太平州亦望风款附。

translations.literal: Taiping Prefecture also submitted at the sight of their approach.
translations.idiomatic: Taiping Prefecture submitted as soon as they appeared.

sentences.zh: 其父唆都因说下建康。

translations.literal: His father Suodu had been the one who persuaded Jiankang to submit.
translations.idiomatic: This owed to his father Suodu, who had talked Jiankang into surrendering.

sentences.zh: 于是伯颜令谒只里论诸将功。

translations.literal: Thereupon Bayan ordered Yezhili to assess the generals' merits.
translations.idiomatic: Bayan then had Yezhili review the generals' achievements.

sentences.zh: 遂赏百家奴银二锭以旌之，仍命为管军总把。

translations.literal: Baijianu was thereupon rewarded with two silver ingots to honor him, and was again appointed commander of army zongba.
translations.idiomatic: Baijianu was rewarded with two silver ingots and kept on as zongba commander.

sentences.zh: 俄从伯颜入朝，加进义校尉，赐银符，为管军总把。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Bayan to court, was promoted to jinyiwei, granted a silver tally, and made commander of army zongba.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Bayan to court, was made a jinyiwei, given a silver tally, and confirmed as zongba commander.

sentences.zh: 攻丹阳、吕城，破常州，皆有功。

translations.literal: Attacking Danyang and Lücheng and breaking Changzhou, he achieved merit in each.
translations.idiomatic: He distinguished himself at Danyang, Lücheng, and the fall of Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 至苏州，宋守臣王安抚以城降。

translations.literal: Reaching Suzhou, Song official Pacification Commissioner Wang surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Suzhou, Song Pacification Commissioner Wang handed over the city.

sentences.zh: 秀州、湖州皆不烦兵而下。

translations.literal: Xiu and Hu prefectures both fell without the trouble of troops.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuzhou and Huzhou fell without a fight.

sentences.zh: 诸军乘胜直趋临安，宋主出降。

translations.literal: The armies, riding victory, pressed straight toward Lin'an, and the Song ruler came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The armies pressed the advantage straight to Lin'an, and the Song emperor came out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 十三年，领新附军守镇江。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he led newly submitted troops to garrison Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 he commanded newly submitted troops garrisoning Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 未几，复从平章博鲁欢攻泰、寿二州，中疮，遂罢攻。

translations.literal: Before long he again followed Pacification Commissioner Boluhuan in attacking Tai and Shou prefectures, received a wound, and the attack was then halted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he joined Pacification Commissioner Boluhuan in attacking Taizhou and Shouzhou, was wounded, and the assault was called off.

sentences.zh: 后数日，与万户叶了虔将兵攻泰州新城，百家奴力疾先登，破之，复被两疮。

translations.literal: Several days later, together with wanhu Ye Leqian he led troops to attack the new city of Taizhou; Baijianu, forcing himself though ill, was first to ascend and storm it, and again received two wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Days later he and Wanhu Ye Leqian assaulted Taizhou's new fort. Baijianu, sick but forcing himself forward, was first over the wall and took it — and was wounded twice more.

sentences.zh: 已而从阿术攻下扬州诸郡，得宋制置李庭芝、都统姜才，以功升武略将军，赐金符，为管军总管，镇高邮白马湖。

translations.literal: Thereafter he followed Aju in capturing the prefectures of Yang Prefecture, obtained Song commander-in-chief Li Tingzhi and commander-in-chief Jiang Cai, and for his merit was promoted to General of Military Strategy, granted a gold tally, made commander-in-chief of army zongguan, and garrisoned Baima Lake in Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Aju in taking the Yangzhou region, captured Song commander-in-chief Li Tingzhi and commander Jiang Cai, and for his service was made a wulue general with a gold tally, appointed zongguan commander, and posted to Baima Lake in Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 是时，行省以百家奴袭父唆都郢复州招讨使、建康宣抚使，仍领本翼军。

translations.literal: At that time the branch secretariat had Baijianu inherit his father Suodu's posts as Pacification Commissioner of Ying and Fu prefectures and Pacification Commissioner of Jiankang, while he still led his own wing army.
translations.idiomatic: The branch secretariat then had Baijianu inherit his father Suodu's posts as Ying-Fu pacification commissioner and Jiankang pacification commissioner, while he kept command of his own wing.

sentences.zh: 顷之，徇地福建，行定衢、婺、信等州城邑。

translations.literal: Shortly after, pacifying lands in Fujian, he settled the cities and towns of Qu, Wu, Xin, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he pacified Fujian, securing the cities of Qu, Wu, Xin, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 至新安县，击斩宋赵监军、詹知县，擒江通判。

translations.literal: Reaching Xin'an County, he struck and killed Song Supervisor Zhao and Prefect Zhan and captured Vice Prefect Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: At Xin'an County he killed Song Supervisor Zhao and Prefect Zhan and took Vice Prefect Jiang prisoner.

sentences.zh: 道与畲军遇，疾战败之。

translations.literal: On the march they encountered She tribal troops; swiftly they battled and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: En route they met a She tribal force and routed it at once.

sentences.zh: 鼓行而东，沈安抚以建宁府降。

translations.literal: Beating drums they advanced eastward; Pacification Commissioner Shen surrendered Jianning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They marched east with drums rolling, and Pacification Commissioner Shen yielded Jianning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 攻陷南剑州，张清、聂文庆遁去。

translations.literal: They assaulted and took Nanjian Prefecture; Zhang Qing and Nie Wenqing fled.
translations.idiomatic: Nanjian Prefecture fell to their assault, and Zhang Qing and Nie Wenqing escaped.

sentences.zh: 闽清、怀安二县传檄而定。

translations.literal: Minqing and Huai'an—the two counties—were settled by transmitted proclamations alone.
translations.idiomatic: Proclamations alone brought Minqing and Huai'an counties into submission.

sentences.zh: 至福州，谕以威德，王安抚率众出降。

translations.literal: Arriving at Fuzhou, they were instructed in authority and virtue; Pacification Commissioner Wang led the crowd out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuzhou they were won over by a display of might and clemency, and Pacification Commissioner Wang came out leading his men to surrender.

sentences.zh: 攻破兴化，擒陈安抚及白牒都统。

translations.literal: They stormed and broke Xinghua, capturing Pacification Commissioner Chen and the White Order Commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: They seized Xinghua, taking Pacification Commissioner Chen and the White Order Commander-in-chief captive.

sentences.zh: 别击东华乡。

translations.literal: Separately they struck Donghua Township.
translations.idiomatic: A detachment attacked Donghua Township.

sentences.zh: 张世杰军于泉州，俄领诸军乘战船入海，追逐张世杰于惠州甲子门。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie had encamped at Quanzhou; soon Baijianu led the armies aboard warships into the sea and pursued Zhang Shijie to Jiazi Gate at Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie held Quanzhou, but soon Baijianu put the fleet to sea and chased him to Jiazi Gate off Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 进至同安县答关寨，濒海县镇悉招谕下之。

translations.literal: Advancing to Daguan Stockade in Tong'an County, all coastal counties and towns were fully summoned and instructed into submission.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed on to Daguan Stockade in Tong'an County and won over every coastal county and town by proclamation.

sentences.zh: 白望丹、五虎陈以战船三千餘艘来降。

translations.literal: Bai Wangdan and Wuhu Chen came to surrender with more than three thousand warships.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Wangdan and Wuhu Chen surrendered with more than three thousand war junks.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，宋二王遣倪宙奉表诣军门降，遂进兵至广州，诸郡县以次降附。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, the two Song princes sent Ni Zhou to present a memorial of submission at the army gate; then they advanced to Guangzhou, and prefectures and counties submitted one after another.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the twelfth month, the two Song princes sent Ni Zhou with a formal surrender at the camp gate. The army then marched on Guangzhou, and prefectures and counties fell in succession.

sentences.zh: 明年春正月，振旅而还，复攻下德胜等寨。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring the following year, they reformed the army and returned, again assaulting and taking Desheng and other stockades.
translations.idiomatic: The following spring he withdrew his troops in good order, then on the return march captured Desheng and other fortified camps.

sentences.zh: 至蒲仙江，聂文庆复败走。

translations.literal: Reaching the Puxian River, Nie Wenqing was again defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: At the Puxian River Nie Wenqing was beaten once more and driven off.

sentences.zh: 攻潮州，破之，诛马发等数人，广东遂平。

translations.literal: They attacked Chaozhou, broke it, executed Ma Fa and several others; Guangdong was thus pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhou was stormed and taken; Ma Fa and several others were executed, and Guangdong was pacified.

sentences.zh: 三月，引宙奉降表来朝，未至，授昭勇大将军，赐虎符，管军万户。

translations.literal: In the third month, leading Ni Zhou with the surrender memorial to court—before arrival he was appointed General of Resolute Valor, granted a tiger tally, and made commander of ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he set out for court escorting Ni Zhou and the surrender memorial. Before he arrived, he was made General of Resolute Valor, given a tiger tally, and appointed commander of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 七月，遂朝于上都，升镇国上将军、海外诸蕃宣慰使，兼福建道市舶提举，仍领本翼军守福建，俄兼福建道长司宣慰使都元帅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he then had audience at Shangdu, was promoted to General Superior in Stabilizing the State and Pacification Commissioner over the Overseas Fan Domains, concurrently made Supervisor of Maritime Trade on the Fujian Circuit, still commanding his own wing to garrison Fujian; soon he also held the posts of Pacification Commissioner and Grand Marshal of the Fujian Circuit Chief Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he had audience at Shangdu and was promoted to general superior in stabilizing the state and pacification commissioner over the overseas fan domains, with concurrent charge of Fujian maritime trade. He kept command of his wing to garrison Fujian and soon added the posts of Fujian pacification commissioner and grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 是时，福建多水灾，百家奴出私钱市米以赈，贫民全活者甚众。

translations.literal: At this time Fujian suffered many flood disasters; Baijianu spent his private funds to buy rice for relief, and very many poor people were wholly preserved alive.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian was then ravaged by floods. Baijianu spent his own money to buy rice for relief, and a great many of the poor were saved.

sentences.zh: 十七年，朝京师，加正奉大夫、宣慰使、都元帅。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he had audience at the capital and was further given the titles of Regular Grand Master, Pacification Commissioner, and Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 17 he went to court and was further made regular grand master, pacification commissioner, and grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，从父唆都征交趾，唆都力战死之，百家奴遂与脱欢引兵薄交趾境，水陆转战，战辄有功。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he followed his father Suodu on campaign against Annam; Suodu fought strenuously and died in battle; Baijianu then with Toghon led troops to press the Annam border, fighting by land and water, and whenever they fought there was merit.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 22 he followed his father Suodu against Annam. Suodu fought to the death; Baijianu then joined Toghon and pressed the Annam frontier by land and sea, winning distinction in every engagement.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，驿召至南京宣慰司，命括五路民马。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was summoned by post to the Nanjing Pacification Commission and ordered to register civilian horses from five circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 25 he was summoned by courier to the Nanjing pacification commission and ordered to levy civilian horses from five circuits.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，除建康路总管。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was appointed Chief Administrator of Jiankang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 27 he was made chief administrator of Jiankang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，迁镇江路总管。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wuzong took the throne, he was transferred to Chief Administrator of Zhenjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzong came to the throne he was transferred to chief administrator of Zhenjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 至大四年，金疮发，卒于家。

translations.literal: In Zhida 4 an old battle wound reopened; he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 an old battle wound reopened and he died at home.

sentences.zh: ○李恆

translations.literal: ○ Li Heng
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng

sentences.zh: 李恆，字德卿，其先姓于弥氏，唐末赐姓李，世为西夏国主。

translations.literal: Li Heng, courtesy name Deqing, his ancestors bore the surname Yumi; at the end of Tang they were granted the surname Li, and for generations were lords of the Western Xia state.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng, courtesy name Deqing, came of the Yumi clan. At the end of Tang the family was granted the surname Li and for generations had been lords of Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 太祖经略河西，有守兀纳剌城者，夏主之子也，城陷不屈而死。

translations.literal: When Taizu was securing the Hexi region, there was one who defended Unal City—he was a son of the Xia ruler; when the city fell he would not submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu was securing the Hexi region, a son of the Xia ruler held Unal City. When the city fell he refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 子惟忠，方七岁，求从父死，主将异之，执以献宗王合撒兒，王留养之。

translations.literal: His son Weizhong, just seven years old, asked to follow his father in death; the commander was struck by this, seized him and presented him to Prince Hésà'ér, and the prince kept and raised him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Weizhong was only seven. He asked to die with his father. The commander was astonished, took him, and presented him to Prince Hésà'ér, who kept and raised him.

sentences.zh: 及嗣王移相哥立，惟忠从经略中原，有功。

translations.literal: When the succeeding prince Yixiangge took the throne, Weizhong followed in securing the Central Plains and had merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the succeeding prince Yixiangge came to power, Weizhong took part in securing the Central Plains and won distinction.

sentences.zh: 淄川王分地，以惟忠为达鲁花赤，佩金符。

translations.literal: When Prince of Zichuan was allotted his domain, Weizhong was made darughachi and wore a gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Zichuan received his fief, Weizhong was made darughachi and given a gold tally.

sentences.zh: 惟忠生恆，恆生有异质，王妃抚之犹己子。

translations.literal: Weizhong begot Heng; Heng from birth had an unusual quality, and the princess consort reared him as her own son.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhong fathered Heng, who from childhood showed unusual promise. The princess consort raised him as if he were her own son.

sentences.zh: 中统三年，命恆为尚书断事官，恆以让其兄。

translations.literal: In Zhongtong 3 Heng was appointed Ministerial Adjudication Officer of the Secretariat; Heng yielded the post to his elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 3 Heng was appointed ministerial adjudication officer, but he yielded the post to his elder brother.

sentences.zh: 李璮反涟海，恆从其父弃家入告变，璮怒，系恆阖门狱中。

translations.literal: Li Tan rebelled at Lianhai; Heng followed his father, abandoning home to enter and report the mutiny; Tan was enraged and imprisoned Heng's entire household in jail.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Tan rebelled at Lianhai, Heng went with his father, left home, and reported the revolt. Tan was furious and threw Heng's whole household into prison.

sentences.zh: 璮诛，得出。

translations.literal: When Tan was executed, he was able to come out.
translations.idiomatic: After Tan was executed he was released.

sentences.zh: 世祖嘉其功，授淄莱路奥鲁总管，佩金符，并偿其所失家资。

translations.literal: Kublai praised his merit, appointed him Ordo Chief Administrator of Zilai Circuit, granted a gold tally, and also compensated the household property he had lost.
translations.idiomatic: Kublai praised his service, made him ordo chief administrator of Zilai Circuit, gave him a gold tally, and compensated him for the property his family had lost.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，改宣武将军、益都淄莱新军万户，从伐宋。

translations.literal: In Zhiyuan 7 he was changed to General of Manifest Martiality and Wanhu of the Yidu-Zilai New Army, following on the campaign against Song.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7 he became general of manifest martiality and wanhu of the Yidu-Zilai new army and joined the campaign against Song.

sentences.zh: 襄阳守将吕文焕时出拒敌，殿帅范文虎复援之。

translations.literal: Xiangyang's defending general Lü Wenhuan at times came out to resist the enemy; Rear Guard Commander Fan Wenhu again came to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangyang's defender Lü Wenhuan sallied out from time to time, and Rear Guard Commander Fan Wenhu kept sending relief.

sentences.zh: 恆率本军筑堡万山扼城西，绝其陆路。

translations.literal: Heng led his own army to build a fort at Wanshan, choking off the west of the city and cutting its land route.
translations.idiomatic: Heng led his troops to build a fort at Wanshan, blocking the west side of the city and cutting its land route.

sentences.zh: 文焕等又以渔舟渡汉水窥伺军形，恆设伏败之，水路亦绝，遂进攻樊城。

translations.literal: Wenhuan and the others again used fishing boats to cross the Han River and spy on the army's dispositions; Heng set an ambush and defeated them, the water route too was cut off, and then they pressed the attack on Fancheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wenhuan also sent fishing boats across the Han to scout the Yuan lines. Heng ambushed and routed them, cutting the water route as well, then pressed the assault on Fancheng.

sentences.zh: 十年春，恆以精兵渡汉，自南面先登，樊城破，襄阳亦降。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year Heng with crack troops crossed the Han, from the south was first to scale the wall; Fancheng was broken, and Xiangyang also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Zhiyuan 10 Heng crossed the Han with elite troops and was first over the wall from the south. Fancheng fell, and Xiangyang surrendered.

sentences.zh: 捷闻，帝赐以宝刀，迁明威将军，佩金虎符。

translations.literal: When the victory was reported, the Emperor bestowed a precious sword, promoted him to General of Bright Martiality, and granted a gold tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory reached the throne, the emperor gave him a treasured sword, promoted him to general of bright martiality, and granted a gold tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 十一年，丞相伯颜大会师襄阳，进至郢州。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Chancellor Bayan massed the armies at Xiangyang and advanced to Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 11 Chancellor Bayan gathered the armies at Xiangyang and marched on Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宋以舟师截汉水，伯颜由唐港入汉，舍郢而进攻沙洋、新城，留恆为后拒，败其追兵。

translations.literal: Song used a fleet to block the Han River; Bayan entered the Han by Tang Harbor, left Ying and advanced to attack Shayang and Xincheng, leaving Heng as rear guard, and defeated their pursuing troops.
translations.idiomatic: Song blocked the Han with a fleet. Bayan entered the river at Tang Harbor, bypassed Ying, and struck Shayang and Xincheng, leaving Heng to cover the rear and beat off the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 至阳罗堡，宋制置夏贵遣其子松来逆战，恆先陷阵，额中流矢，伯颜止之，恆战益力，卒射松杀之。

translations.literal: Reaching Yangluo Fort, Song commander-in-chief Xia Gui sent his son Song to meet them in battle; Heng was first to break the enemy line, an arrow struck his forehead; Bayan stopped him, but Heng fought with greater force and in the end shot Song and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: At Yangluo Fort, Song commander-in-chief Xia Gui sent his son Song to fight. Heng was first into the enemy line and took an arrow in the forehead. Bayan tried to hold him back, but Heng fought all the harder and finally shot Song dead.

sentences.zh: 诸军渡江，恆与宋兵战，自寅至申，夏贵败走，鄂州、汉阳俱下。

translations.literal: The armies crossed the Yangzi; Heng fought with Song troops from the yin hour to the shen hour; Xia Gui was defeated and fled; E Prefecture and Hanyang were both taken.
translations.idiomatic: The armies crossed the Yangzi. Heng fought the Song from dawn to mid-afternoon. Xia Gui was routed, and E Prefecture and Hanyang both fell.

sentences.zh: 以功迁宣威将军，赐白金五百两。

translations.literal: For merit he was promoted to General of Manifest Martial Authority and granted five hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he was promoted to general of manifest martial authority and given five hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 遂从伯颜东下。

translations.literal: He then followed Bayan eastward downstream.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Bayan downstream to the east.

sentences.zh: 十二年春，宋将高世杰复窥汉、沔，乃遣恆还守鄂州。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twelfth year Song general Gao Shijie again spied on Han and Mian; Heng was then sent back to garrison E Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Zhiyuan 12 Song general Gao Shijie probed Han and Mian again, and Heng was sent back to hold E Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 时豪民聚众侵江陵，省命恆往讨之，恆敛兵不动，但谕使出降，得生口十餘万，悉纵为民；

translations.literal: At the time powerful locals gathered crowds and raided Jiangling; the branch secretariat ordered Heng to go punish them. Heng held his troops in check and did not move, only instructing them to come out and surrender; he took more than one hundred thousand captives and released them all to become commoners;
translations.idiomatic: Local strongmen had gathered mobs and were raiding Jiangling. The branch secretariat ordered Heng to suppress them. He held his army still and simply called on them to surrender. More than one hundred thousand captives were taken and all released to return to civilian life;

sentences.zh: 仍禁军毋得虏掠，馈献充积一无所受。

translations.literal: He also forbade the army from seizing and plundering; gifts piled up in abundance and he accepted not one.
translations.idiomatic: He also forbade his troops to loot, and though gifts piled up around him he accepted none.

sentences.zh: 十二年，从右丞阿里海牙至洞庭，擒高世杰。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he followed Right Counsellor Arighaiya to Dongting Lake and captured Gao Shijie.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 12 he followed right counsellor Arighaiya to Dongting Lake and captured Gao Shijie.

sentences.zh: 下岳州，进攻沙市，拔之。

translations.literal: They took Yue Prefecture, advanced to attack Shashi, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Prefecture fell; they stormed Shashi and took it.

sentences.zh: 宋制置高达以江陵降，留恆镇守。

translations.literal: Song commander-in-chief Gao Da surrendered Jiangling; Heng was left to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: Song commander-in-chief Gao Da surrendered Jiangling, and Heng was left to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 传檄归、峡、辰、沅、靖、澧、常德诸州，皆下。

translations.literal: Proclamations were sent to Gui, Xia, Chen, Yuan, Jing, Li, and Changde prefectures, and all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Proclamations went out to Gui, Xia, Chen, Yuan, Jing, Li, and Changde, and all submitted.

sentences.zh: 未几，徙镇常德，以扼湖南之冲。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to garrison Changde, to choke off the gateway of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to Changde to hold the gateway into Hunan.

sentences.zh: 俄有诏分三道出师，以恆为左副都元帅，从都元帅逊都台出江西。

translations.literal: Soon an edict ordered three columns to take the field; Heng was made Left Vice Grand Marshal and followed Grand Marshal Sundutai out through Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon ordered a three-pronged advance. Heng was made left vice grand marshal and marched into Jiangxi under Grand Marshal Sundutai.

sentences.zh: 九月，开府于江州。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he opened a headquarters at Jiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he established headquarters at Jiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 师次建昌县，擒都统熊飞。

translations.literal: The army halted at Jianchang County and captured Commander-in-chief Xiong Fei.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Jianchang County and captured Commander-in-chief Xiong Fei.

sentences.zh: 遂围隆兴，转运使刘盘请降，恆察其诈，密为之备。

translations.literal: Then they besieged Longxing; Transport Commissioner Liu Pan asked to surrender; Heng perceived the deception and secretly made preparations.
translations.idiomatic: They then besieged Longxing. Transport Commissioner Liu Pan offered to surrender, but Heng saw through the ruse and quietly prepared.

sentences.zh: 盘果以锐兵空至，恆击败之，杀获殆尽，盘乃降。

translations.literal: Pan indeed sent crack troops in a surprise attack; Heng defeated them, killing and capturing nearly all; only then did Pan surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Pan duly sent elite troops in a surprise strike. Heng routed them, killing or capturing nearly all, and Pan then surrendered.

sentences.zh: 下抚、瑞、建昌、临江。

translations.literal: They took Fu, Rui, Jianchang, and Linjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Fu, Rui, Jianchang, and Linjiang fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 军中有得宋相文天祥与建昌故吏民书，恆焚之，人心乃安。

translations.literal: In the army someone obtained letters from Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang to former officials and commoners of Jianchang; Heng burned them, and people's hearts were then settled.
translations.idiomatic: Someone in the army came into possession of letters from Song chancellor Wen Tianxiang to former officials and people of Jianchang. Heng burned them, and public feeling settled.

sentences.zh: 进攻吉州，知州周天骥降，遂定赣、南安。

translations.literal: They advanced to attack Ji Prefecture; Prefect Zhou Tianji surrendered, and then Gan and Nan'an were secured.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Ji Prefecture; Prefect Zhou Tianji surrendered, and Gan and Nan'an were secured.

sentences.zh: 广东经略徐直谅奉蜡书纳其所部十四郡，前江西制置黄万石亦以邵武降。

translations.literal: Guangdong Military Commissioner Xu Zhiliang presented a sealed letter offering the fourteen prefectures under his command; former Jiangxi commander-in-chief Huang Wanshi also surrendered Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong military commissioner Xu Zhiliang sent a sealed letter offering the fourteen prefectures under his command. Former Jiangxi commander-in-chief Huang Wanshi also surrendered Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 隆兴帅府诬富民与敌连，已诛百三十家，恆还，审其非罪，尽释之。

translations.literal: The Longxing commandery accused wealthy households of colluding with the enemy and had already executed one hundred thirty families; when Heng returned he examined the cases, found them not guilty, and released them all.
translations.idiomatic: The Longxing commandery had accused wealthy families of colluding with the enemy and executed one hundred thirty households. When Heng returned he reviewed the cases, found them innocent, and released them all.

sentences.zh: 宋丞相陈宜中及其大将张世杰立益王鸑于闽中，郡县豪杰争起兵应之。

translations.literal: Song chancellor Chen Yizhong and his great general Zhang Shijie enthroned Prince Yi Zhao in Fujian; county and prefecture heroes vied to raise troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: Song chancellor Chen Yizhong and his chief general Zhang Shijie enthroned Prince Yi in Fujian, and local leaders across the counties and prefectures raced to raise troops in support.

sentences.zh: 恆遣将破吴浚兵于南丰。

translations.literal: Heng sent a general to defeat Wu Jun's troops at Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Heng sent a general who routed Wu Jun's force at Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 世杰遣都统张文虎与浚合兵十万，期必复建昌。

translations.literal: Shijie sent Commander-in-chief Zhang Wenhu to join forces with Jun—one hundred thousand men in all—with a fixed date to recover Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie sent Commander-in-chief Zhang Wenhu to join Wu Jun with one hundred thousand men, determined to retake Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 恆复遣将败之兜港。

translations.literal: Heng again sent a general to defeat them at Dougang.
translations.idiomatic: Heng sent another general and defeated them at Dougang.

sentences.zh: 浚走从文天祥于瑞金，又破之，天祥走汀州。

translations.literal: Jun fled to join Wen Tianxiang at Ruijin; they were again defeated, and Tianxiang fled to Ting Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jun fled to Wen Tianxiang at Ruijin. They were beaten again, and Tianxiang withdrew to Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 遣镇抚孔遵追之，并破赵孟瀯军，取汀州。

translations.literal: He sent Pacification Commissioner Kong Zun in pursuit, also defeated Zhao Mengyin's army, and took Ting Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He sent pacification commissioner Kong Zun in pursuit, routed Zhao Mengyin's army as well, and took Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元帅府罢，授昭勇大将军、同知江西宣慰司事，加镇国上将军，迁福建宣慰使，改江西宣慰使。

translations.literal: When the grand marshal headquarters was abolished, he was appointed General of Resolute Valor and Associate Manager of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, further made General Superior in Stabilizing the State, transferred to Pacification Commissioner of Fujian, then changed to Pacification Commissioner of Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: When the grand marshal headquarters was dissolved he was made general of resolute valor and associate manager of the Jiangxi pacification commission, promoted to general superior in stabilizing the state, appointed pacification commissioner of Fujian, and then transferred to pacification commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 天祥复取汀州，兵出兴国县，连破诸邑，围赣州尤急。

translations.literal: Tianxiang again took Ting Prefecture; his troops came out from Xingguo County, broke several towns in succession, and the siege of Gan Prefecture grew especially pressing.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang retook Ting Prefecture, marched out from Xingguo County, captured several towns in succession, and pressed the siege of Gan Prefecture hard.

sentences.zh: 或言天祥坟墓在吉州者，若遣兵发之，则必下矣。

translations.literal: Someone said that since Tianxiang's ancestral tombs were in Ji Prefecture, if troops were sent to exhume them he would surely submit.
translations.idiomatic: Someone suggested that since Tianxiang's family tombs were in Ji Prefecture, exhuming them would force his surrender.

sentences.zh: 恆曰：「王师讨不服耳，岂有发人坟墓之理！」

translations.literal: Heng said: "The royal army punishes only those who will not submit—how could there be any principle of digging up people's graves!"
translations.idiomatic: Heng said, "The imperial army is here to punish defiance. What principle is there in desecrating a man's graves?"

sentences.zh: 乃分兵援赣，自率精兵潜至兴国。

translations.literal: He then divided troops to relieve Gan and personally led crack troops secretly to Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: He split off troops to relieve Gan and led elite forces in secret to Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 天祥走，追至空坑，获其妻女，擒招讨使赵时赏已下二十餘人，降其众二十万。

translations.literal: Tianxiang fled; they pursued to Kongkeng, captured his wife and daughters, seized Pacification Commissioner Zhao Shishang and more than twenty others below him, and accepted the surrender of two hundred thousand of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Tianxiang fled. They pursued him to Kongkeng, took his wife and daughters, captured pacification commissioner Zhao Shishang and more than twenty of his officers, and accepted the surrender of two hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 有旨令与右丞阿里罕、左丞董文炳合兵追益王。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him to join forces with Right Counsellor Alighan and Left Counsellor Dong Wenbing to pursue Prince Yi.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to join right counsellor Alighan and left counsellor Dong Wenbing in pursuing Prince Yi.

sentences.zh: 众议所向，皆谓宜趋福建，恆曰：「不可。

translations.literal: The assembly debated where to advance; all said they ought to hurry to Fujian; Heng said: "That will not do.
translations.idiomatic: When the commanders debated their route, all favored rushing into Fujian. Heng said, "That will not do.

sentences.zh: 若诸军俱在福建，彼必窜广东，则梅岭、江西非我有矣，宜从广东夹攻之。」

translations.literal: If all our armies are in Fujian, they will surely flee into Guangdong, and then Meiling Pass and Jiangxi will no longer be ours; we ought to strike from Guangdong in a pincer attack."
translations.idiomatic: If all our armies mass in Fujian, they will slip into Guangdong, and we will lose Meiling Pass and Jiangxi. We should strike from Guangdong and catch them in a pincer."

sentences.zh: 众以为然。

translations.literal: The assembly agreed.
translations.idiomatic: The others agreed.

sentences.zh: 兵至梅岭，果与宋兵遇，出其不意败之，乃遁走碙 州。

translations.literal: When the army reached Meiling Pass they indeed met Song troops, defeated them by surprise, and the Song force fled in flight to Qiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: At Meiling Pass they met the Song army as expected, routed them by surprise, and the Song force fled to Qiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，拜参知政事，行省江西。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed Vice Grand Councillor with charge of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 14 he was made vice grand councillor with charge of the Jiangxi branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十五年，益王殂，其枢密张世杰、陆秀夫等复立卫王昺，守广东诸郡，诏以恆为蒙古汉军都元帅经略之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Prince Yi died; his Bureau of Military Affairs chiefs Zhang Shijie, Lu Xiufu, and others again enthroned Prince Wei Zhao Bing and held the prefectures of Guangdong; an edict made Heng Grand Marshal of Mongol and Han Armies to secure the region.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 15 Prince Yi died. Zhang Shijie, Lu Xiufu, and other military affairs chiefs enthroned Prince Wei and held out in the Guangdong prefectures. Heng was ordered to take the field as grand marshal of Mongol and Han armies to secure the region.

sentences.zh: 恆进兵取英德府、清远县，败其制置凌震、运使王道夫，遂入广州，世杰等移屯崖山。

translations.literal: Heng advanced to take Yingde Prefecture and Qingyuan County, defeated their commander-in-chief Ling Zhen and Transport Commissioner Wang Daofu, then entered Guangzhou; Shijie and the others shifted camp to Yamen Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Heng marched on Yingde Prefecture and Qingyuan County, defeated commander-in-chief Ling Zhen and transport commissioner Wang Daofu, and entered Guangzhou. Shijie and the others withdrew to Yamen Mountain.

sentences.zh: 时都元帅张弘范舟师未至，恆按兵不动，分遣诸将略定梅、循诸州。

translations.literal: At the time Grand Marshal Zhang Hongfan's fleet had not yet arrived; Heng held his troops still and sent generals in separate columns to secure Mei, Xun, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal Zhang Hongfan's fleet had not yet arrived, so Heng held his army in place and sent generals to secure Mei, Xun, and the other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 凌震等复抵广州，恆击败之，皆弃舟走，赴水死，夺其船三百艘，擒将吏宋迈以下二百餘人，又破其餘军于茭塘越。

translations.literal: Ling Zhen and the others again reached Guangzhou; Heng defeated them; all abandoned their boats and fled, drowning in the water; three hundred ships were captured, officers and clerks including Song Mai and more than two hundred others were seized, and the remaining army was again defeated at Jiaotangyue.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Zhen struck at Guangzhou again. Heng routed them; they abandoned their ships and fled into the water to their deaths. Three hundred vessels were captured, more than two hundred officers including Song Mai were taken, and the rest of their force was broken at Jiaotangyue.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月，弘范至自漳州，直指崖山，恆率所部赴之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixteenth year Hongfan arrived from Zhang Prefecture, pointed straight at Yamen Mountain, and Heng led his own command to join him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Zhiyuan 16 Hongfan arrived from Zhang Prefecture and made straight for Yamen Mountain. Heng marched to join him with his command.

sentences.zh: 张世杰集海舰千餘艘，贯以巨索，为栅以自固。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie gathered more than a thousand seagoing warships, threaded them with huge ropes, and made a palisade to secure himself.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie massed more than a thousand warships, lashed them together with great ropes, and built a floating palisade for defense.

sentences.zh: 恆遣断其汲路，其势日迫，谕降不可，乃阵于船尾，由北面逆行，捣其栅。

translations.literal: Heng sent men to cut off their route for drawing water; their situation grew daily more pressing; he instructed them to surrender but they would not; then he formed ranks on the sterns of the ships, from the north side rowed against the current, and smashed their palisade.
translations.idiomatic: Heng cut off their water supply, tightening the noose day by day. When they refused surrender he formed his men on the sterns of the ships, rowed upstream from the north, and smashed their palisade.

sentences.zh: 索绝，世杰犹死战，自朝至晡，弘范督南面诸军合击，大败之。

translations.literal: The ropes broke; Shijie still fought to the death; from morning to late afternoon Hongfan directed the southern armies in a combined assault and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: The ropes gave way, but Shijie still fought to the death. From morning until late afternoon Hongfan drove the southern wing in a combined assault and broke them completely.

sentences.zh: 陆秀夫先沉妻子于海，乃抱卫王赴海死。

translations.literal: Lu Xiufu first drowned his wife and children in the sea, then carrying Prince Wei he went into the sea and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xiufu drowned his wife and children in the sea, then took Prince Wei in his arms and leapt into the waves to his death.

sentences.zh: 从死者十餘万人。

translations.literal: Those who followed in death numbered more than one hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: More than one hundred thousand followed them to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 获其金玺、后宫及文武之臣。

translations.literal: They captured the golden seal, the inner palace, and civil and military ministers.
translations.idiomatic: They captured the imperial seal, the women of the inner palace, and the civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 其大将翟国秀、凌震等皆解甲降。

translations.literal: Their great generals Zhai Guoxiu, Ling Zhen, and others all removed their armor and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Their chief generals Zhai Guoxiu, Ling Zhen, and others laid down their arms and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 焚溺之余，尚得八百餘艘。

translations.literal: After burning and drowning, more than eight hundred ships were still obtained.
translations.idiomatic: After the burning and drowning, more than eight hundred ships were still recovered.

sentences.zh: 是日，黑气如雾，有乘舟南遁者，恆以为卫王，追至高、化，询之降人，始知卫王已死，遁者乃世杰也。

translations.literal: That day black vapor like mist arose; there was one who fled south by boat; Heng thought it was Prince Wei; they pursued to Gao and Hua; questioning surrendered men, they then learned Prince Wei was already dead—the fugitive was Shijie.
translations.idiomatic: That day black mist rolled over the sea. Someone fled south by boat, and Heng took him for Prince Wei. They pursued as far as Gao and Hua, but questioning prisoners revealed that Prince Wei was already dead—the fugitive was Shijie.

sentences.zh: 世杰继亦溺死于海陵港。

translations.literal: Shijie afterward also drowned and died at Hailing Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie too drowned soon after at Hailing Harbor.

sentences.zh: 岭海悉平，功成入觐，帝赏劳甚厚，将士预赐宴者二百餘人。

translations.literal: The Lingnan coast was wholly pacified; when the achievement was complete he entered audience; the Emperor rewarded and commended him very generously; officers and soldiers granted banquets in advance numbered more than two hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The Lingnan coast was fully pacified. Heng returned to court in triumph, and the emperor rewarded him lavishly. More than two hundred officers and soldiers were honored at a feast.

sentences.zh: 十七年，拜资善大夫、中书左丞，行省荆湖。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was appointed Grand Master for Excellent Counsel, Left Counsellor of the Central Secretariat, with charge of the Jing-Hu Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 17 he was made grand master for excellent counsel and left counsellor of the central secretariat with charge of the Jing-Hu branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 掠民为奴婢者，禁之；

translations.literal: Those who seized commoners to make them slave girls and servants—he prohibited this;
translations.idiomatic: He forbade the seizing of commoners as slaves and servant girls;

sentences.zh: 常德、澧、辰、沅、靖五郡之饥者，赈之；

translations.literal: The hungry in the five prefectures of Changde, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing were given relief;
translations.idiomatic: He gave relief to the hungry in Changde, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing;

sentences.zh: 猎户之籍于官者，奏请一千户之外，悉放散之。

translations.literal: as for hunters registered with the government, he memorialized that beyond one thousand households all should be released and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: and memorialized that registered hunters beyond one thousand households should all be released.

sentences.zh: 十九年，乞解军职，乃命其长子同知江西宣慰司事散木兒袭为本军万户。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he requested to be relieved of military office; thereupon his eldest son Sanmu'er, Associate Controller of the Jiangxi Pacification Commission, was ordered to succeed as commander of ten thousand of this army.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 he asked to resign his military post; his eldest son Sanmu'er, associate controller of the Jiangxi pacification commission, succeeded him as commander of ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 占城之役，恆奉旨给其粮饷器械、海舰百艘，久留瘴乡，冒疾而还。

translations.literal: In the Champa campaign Heng received orders to supply grain, pay, weapons, and a hundred seagoing ships; he remained long in miasmal country and returned having braved illness.
translations.idiomatic: For the Champa campaign Heng was ordered to provide grain, arms, and a hundred warships. He stayed long in the fever country and came back ill.

sentences.zh: 俄有诏命恆从皇子镇南王征交趾，结筏渡海，夺天长府。

translations.literal: Before long an edict ordered Heng to follow Prince Zhennan in campaigning against Jiaozhi; they built rafts to cross the sea and took Tianchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was ordered to follow Prince Zhennan against Annam. They rafted across the sea and captured Tianchang.

sentences.zh: 交趾遂空其国，航海而遁。

translations.literal: Jiaozhi thereupon emptied the country and fled by sea.
translations.idiomatic: Annam evacuated the realm and fled by sea.

sentences.zh: 恆封其宫庭府库，追袭于海洋，败之，得船二百艘，几获其世子。

translations.literal: Heng sealed the palace and government storehouses, pursued them on the ocean, defeated them, captured two hundred ships, and nearly seized the heir.
translations.idiomatic: Heng sealed the palace treasuries, pursued them at sea, routed their fleet, took two hundred ships, and nearly captured the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 会盛夏，军中疾作，霖潦暴涨，浸濯营地。

translations.literal: It happened to be high summer; epidemic broke out in the army, torrential rains swelled violently, and flooded the camps.
translations.idiomatic: In the height of summer sickness swept the army, rains swelled, and the camps were flooded.

sentences.zh: 议者谓交趾且降，请班师，恆弗能夺，遂还。

translations.literal: Counsellors said Jiaozhi was about to surrender and asked to withdraw the army; Heng could not prevail over them, and they returned.
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that Annam was about to submit and urged withdrawal. Heng could not change their minds, and the army turned back.

sentences.zh: 蛮兵追败后军，王乃改命恆殿后，且战且行。

translations.literal: Barbarian troops pursued and defeated the rear guard; the prince then changed orders and made Heng command the rear, fighting as they marched.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal troops routed the rear guard. The prince then put Heng in command of the rearguard, fighting all the way out.

sentences.zh: 毒矢贯恆膝，一卒负恆而趋。

translations.literal: A poisoned arrow pierced Heng's knee; one soldier carried Heng as he hurried along.
translations.idiomatic: A poisoned arrow struck Heng's knee, and a soldier carried him forward.

sentences.zh: 至思明州，毒发，卒，年五十。

translations.literal: When he reached Siming Prefecture the poison took effect and he died, aged fifty.
translations.idiomatic: At Siming the poison took hold and he died, aged fifty.

sentences.zh: 后赠银青荣禄大夫、平章政事，谥武愍；

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously given the titles of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Silver-Green Sash and Councillor of State, with the posthumous name Wumin;
translations.idiomatic: He was later posthumously made grand master of splendid happiness with silver-green sash and councillor of state, with the posthumous name Wumin;

sentences.zh: 再赠推忠靖远功臣、太保、仪同三司，追封滕国公。

translations.literal: again he was given the title of Meritorious Minister Who Promotes Loyalty and Pacifies the Distant, Grand Preceptor, and Honorary Three Excellencies, and was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Teng.
translations.idiomatic: and again as meritorious minister who promotes loyalty and pacifies the distant, grand preceptor, and honorary three excellencies, posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Teng.

sentences.zh: 子散木䚟，江西行省平章政事；

translations.literal: His son Sanmu'er was Councillor of the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: His son Sanmu'er was councillor of the Jiangxi branch secretariat;

sentences.zh: 囊加真，益都淄莱万户；

translations.literal: Nangiazhen was Commander of Ten Thousand of Yidu Zilai;
translations.idiomatic: Nangiazhen was commander of ten thousand of Yidu Zilai;

sentences.zh: 逊都台，同知湖南宣慰使司事。

translations.literal: Xundutai was Associate Controller of the Hunan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Xundutai was associate controller of the Hunan pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 孙薛彻干，兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: His grandson Xiechegan was Vice Minister of the Ministry of War;
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Xiechegan was vice minister of war;

sentences.zh: 薛彻秃，益都般阳万户。

translations.literal: Xiechetu was Commander of Ten Thousand of Yidu Banyang.
translations.idiomatic: Xiechetu was commander of ten thousand of Yidu Banyang.
